library_entry.summary: Ketu's seven-year period is described by most texts as unsettled: quarrels, trouble from enemies, thieves or authorities, wounds, fevers, scandal, losses and living away from home. BPHS makes it good, even giving high position, land and family happiness, when Ketu is in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, in a benefic or own/exaltation sign, or in an upachaya house; bad in the 2nd, 8th or 12th or under malefic influence. Because Ketu owns no sign here, much depends on the sign it sits in, its sign lord and the planets joined with it.
common_outcomes: trouble from enemies, thieves and the ruler, wounds from weapons, diseases from heat, false accusation and a stain on the family name, danger from fire, living away from home (Phaladeepika 19.17)
grief and confusion connected with women, trouble from powerful people, loss of wealth, improper conduct, exile, toothache, leg pain and phlegm disorders (Phaladeepika 19.25)
distress, failing judgement, various illnesses and growing physical trouble, a life of much misery with only slight comforts (Jataka Parijata 18.145)
when well placed: favour of rulers, headship of a village or region, vehicles, children, gains from abroad, happiness from the spouse and cattle (BPHS 47.72-74)
rare_outcomes: imprisonment, destruction of kinsmen and of the home, company of low people (BPHS 47.77, when badly placed)
attainment of a kingdom or high government position and opportunities to acquire elephants (BPHS 47.74-75, Ketu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th)
Raman (by sign): founding of sacred institutions (Gemini); misappropriation of funds and prosecution (Capricorn); travel by water to distant countries and respect there (Pisces)

by_area.personality: Failing judgement and distress (Jataka Parijata 18.145); anxiety and fear in the middle of the period (BPHS 47.75); in Raman's sign list, religious study, moral elevation and tolerance in Sagittarius or Pisces, pessimism and dependence in Aquarius.
by_area.career: Favour of rulers, headship of a place and high position when Ketu is in a kendra, trikona, the 11th or an upachaya (BPHS 47.72-75); trouble from the ruler, false accusation and scandal (Phaladeepika 19.17); trouble from powerful people (Phaladeepika 19.25); Raman: promotion and favour of superiors in Pisces, displeasure of superiors in Aquarius.
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 19.25); gains of land, vehicles and cattle when well placed (BPHS 47.72-74); money comes in during the middle of the period (Jataka Parijata 18.157); abundant wealth if Ketu is aspected by a benefic (Jataka Parijata 18.155); waste of wealth through illness if joined with malefics (Jataka Parijata 18.156).
by_area.health: Wounds from weapons, heat diseases, danger from fire (Phaladeepika 19.17); toothache, leg pain, phlegm disorders (Phaladeepika 19.25); various diseases and physical torment (Jataka Parijata 18.145); illness in the last part of the period (BPHS 47.76); disease when Ketu is in the 2nd, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.77).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from the spouse when well placed (BPHS 47.73-74); grief and confusion linked to women (Phaladeepika 19.25); Raman lists sickness or loss of the wife under several signs (Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Capricorn).
by_area.family: Children and growth of the household when well placed (BPHS 47.73-74); elders and relatives fall ill at the start (Jataka Parijata 18.157); loss of kinsmen and of the home when badly placed (BPHS 47.77); stain on the family name (Phaladeepika 19.17).
by_area.spirituality: Raman's sign list stresses pilgrimage and religious study (Taurus), philosophical initiation (Cancer), philosophical debate (Leo), religious discussion (Sagittarius) and religious devotion (Pisces). Raman's list of Ketu's general significations includes religion, astrology and moksha (ch. XXIII). Rath calls Ketu the mokshakaraka.

strengtheners: Ketu in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, in a benefic sign, in its exaltation or own sign (BPHS 47.72)
aspected by a benefic, or in a benefic varga (BPHS 47.72, Sanskrit gloss)
Ketu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th (BPHS 47.74; Santhanam's note on 48.18-20 says the nodes give good results in these upachaya houses)
joined with a benefic (happiness) or aspected by a benefic (abundant wealth) (Jataka Parijata 18.155)
in a kendra or trikona and connected with the lord of a kendra or trikona: acts as a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20.52)
in a sign owned by a benefic and connected with some planet (Phaladeepika 20.53; Raman ch. XVI)
in a kendra or trikona, where the nodes are always good (Rele p. 64)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 2nd, 8th or 12th, or aspected by a malefic (BPHS 47.76-77)
joined with malefics (Jataka Parijata 18.156)
in a sign owned by a malefic (Raman ch. XVI)
Frawley (general Ketu, not dasha-specific): Ketu is weak when the lord of its sign is weak, when it is in the 3rd, 6th or 8th, or when aspected by malefics such as Saturn and Mars
library_entry.phases: BPHS 47.75-76 (Santhanam): raja yoga at the start, fearfulness in the middle, illness and distant journeys in the last part. Jataka Parijata 18.157: elders and relatives fall ill at the start, money comes in the middle, happiness at the end. BPHS 47.3-4: phase results normally follow the planet's drekkana (1st = start, 2nd = middle, 3rd = end) but run in reverse for retrograde planets, and the nodes are always retrograde.
library_entry.disagreements: Sign rulership and dignity: BPHS 47.35-36 gives Ketu exaltation in Scorpio, moolatrikona in Sagittarius and own sign Scorpio (Pisces by some); Rath and Narasimha Rao treat Ketu as co-lord of Scorpio and Rath calls it debilitated in Taurus; Rele (p. 64) and this library say the nodes own no houses, and the library's node dignity (exalted Taurus, debilitated Scorpio) is the reverse of BPHS for Ketu, so sign conditions are written by sign name here. BPHS 47.76-77: Santhanam reads the bad case as the 2nd, 8th or 12th OR malefic aspect; the Sanskrit gloss reads the houses together with malefic influence. Phases: BPHS puts raja yoga at the start, fear in the middle and illness and travel at the end; Jataka Parijata puts illness of elders at the start, money in the middle and happiness at the end. Tone: BPHS and Jataka Parijata 18.155 allow strongly good results, while Phaladeepika 19 and Jataka Parijata 18.145 give only troubles. Raman's 3rd/6th/11th rule (good) contrasts with Frawley's general view that the 3rd, 6th and 8th weaken Ketu.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe the period as one of withdrawal, sudden changes and tests, with real gains possible when the chart shows the listed good placements. Lead with what the chart supports (sign, house, sign lord, companions) rather than the generic list of troubles. Avoid predicting imprisonment, the death of relatives or specific diseases; frame health items as reasons for care. Remedies can be offered as traditional practices, not as guarantees.

library_entry.summary: Venus's 20-year mahadasha, the longest in the Vimshottari cycle, is described as a period of comfort, marriage and family celebration, vehicles, fine clothes, ornaments, wealth, the arts and royal favour when Venus is well placed. BPHS turns it toward quarrels with kin, trouble to the wife, business loss and separation from relatives when Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, and toward bodily trouble when Venus rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: fine clothes, ornaments, conveyances, cattle and land; sweet food daily; recognition from the ruler; music and dance at home by the grace of Lakshmi (BPHS 47.79-82, when Venus is exalted, in its own sign or in a kendra or trikona)
a wife, children, wealth, great comfort, garlands and perfumes, clothes, ornaments, vehicles, and fortune and fame like a king's (Jataka Parijata 18.158)

materials for pleasure and comfort, good vehicles, cows, gems, ornaments and treasure, enjoyment with young women, intellectual work, voyages, auspicious acts and gifts from the ruler (Phaladeepika 19.12)
a wife, jewels, clothes, treasure, horses and the comforts of bed and seat; wealth from trade, farming and voyages (Phaladeepika 19.26)
quarrels with kinsmen, distress to the wife, business losses, loss of cattle and separation from relatives when Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.83-84)
rare_outcomes: a kingdom or high government post, command of an army, marriages and births in the family, recovery of a lost position or property (BPHS 47.81-83, Venus in its moolatrikona)
rulership of a region or village, building temples and reservoirs, giving food in charity (BPHS 47.85-87, Venus in the 4th as 9th or 10th lord)
anxiety, mental distress, separation from or loss of parents and elders, and hardship to relatives (Phaladeepika 19.26)
gems, sharper intellect, great wealth and public praise (Phaladeepika 20.26, Venus strong in own or exaltation sign in the 10th, 11th or 12th)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] when Venus owns kendras and also owns or occupies the 2nd or 7th (Phaladeepika 20.50)

by_area.personality: Pleasure-seeking, intellectual and artistic pursuits (Phaladeepika 19.12); enthusiasm and vigour in work (BPHS 47.87); a period of strong sensuality when Venus is in Libra (Raman p. 276).
by_area.career: Recognition from the ruler, high government post, command of an army when Venus is strong (BPHS 47.79-83); rulership of a region or village as 9th or 10th lord in the 4th (BPHS 47.85-86); business losses when Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.84); promotion to responsible office with Venus in Pisces (Raman p. 277).
by_area.finance: Vehicles, clothes, ornaments, cattle and land (BPHS 47.79-80); wealth, treasure and gems (Jataka Parijata 18.158; Phaladeepika 19.12); income from trade, farming and voyages (Phaladeepika 19.26); loss of wealth and status if Venus is exalted in the rasi but debilitated in the navamsa (Jataka Parijata 18.168).
by_area.health: Bodily pain and trouble when Venus rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 47.88); Raman notes venereal trouble with Venus in Taurus and generative-organ trouble, arthritis and nervous strain with Venus in Virgo (pp. 275-276).
by_area.relationships: Marriage and a wife are central (Jataka Parijata 18.158; Phaladeepika 19.26; BPHS 47.82); distress to and harassment from the wife when Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.84-85); quarrels and separation with Venus in Virgo (Raman p. 276).
by_area.family: Births and marriages in the family, visits of friends (BPHS 47.81-82); happiness from wife and children (BPHS 47.87); enmity with kinsmen and separation from relatives when Venus is in a dusthana (BPHS 47.84-85); anxiety about parents and elders (Phaladeepika 19.26).
by_area.spirituality: Pious works such as building temples and reservoirs and giving grain in charity (BPHS 47.86-87); religious and philosophical study with Venus in Sagittarius (Raman p. 277).

strengtheners: Venus exalted, in its own sign, or in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 47.79)
Venus in its moolatrikona (BPHS 47.81)
Venus in the 4th (Sanskrit: lagna or 4th) as lord of the 9th or 10th (BPHS 47.85)
Venus strong, not combust, free of malefics, in its own or exaltation sign falling in the 10th, 11th or 12th (Phaladeepika 20.26)
Venus debilitated in the rasi but exalted in the navamsa (Jataka Parijata 18.169)
Venus yogakaraka for Capricorn and Aquarius lagnas, and lord of the 2nd and 9th for Virgo lagna (Santhanam's note to BPHS 47.89)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.83); the Sanskrit adds debilitation
Venus lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 47.88)
Venus owning kendras (kendradhipati dosha), worse if it also owns or occupies the 2nd or 7th (Phaladeepika 20.50)
Venus exalted in the rasi but debilitated in the navamsa (Jataka Parijata 18.168)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS 47.85: Santhanam has Venus 'in the 4th' as 9th or 10th lord, while the Sanskrit reads 'in the lagna or the 4th'. BPHS 47.83: the Sanskrit adds debilitation to the 6/8/12 condition, Santhanam omits it. BPHS 47.89 remedy: Santhanam gives Shatarudriya or Mrityunjaya japa, the Sanskrit gloss gives the Rudra or Tryambaka mantra. Both prescribe giving a (white) cow or a buffalo. Phaladeepika 19.26 adds anxiety and loss of parents and elders, which the other classical texts do not mention. Raman's sign-by-sign results make Cancer, Leo, Virgo and Scorpio bad, which follows no dignity rule in BPHS (Cancer and Leo are not Venus's debilitation).
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame the Venus period as a long chapter centred on comfort, relationships, family events, possessions and the arts. Its tone depends on Venus's house, dignity and lordship. Where the chart shows the weak conditions, speak of strain in close relationships and money, and of keeping balance in pleasures. Never predict death, the loss of a parent or a specific illness; for the maraka rule, speak only of a time to look after health.

library_entry.summary: The Sun's six-year period turns on the Sun's strength. A strong, well-placed Sun brings wealth, honour from government and people in power, rank, children, fame and steady effort. A weak or afflicted Sun brings loss of money, displeasure of authorities, quarrels with relatives, worry about the father, fevers and moves away from home.
common_outcomes: when strong: wealth, happiness and honours from the government; gains of clothes, conveyances and produce (BPHS 47.7-11)
when strong: sons, intelligence, wisdom, status, knowledge, wealth, fame, valour and divine blessings (Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6)
when strong: courage, effort, intelligence, fame and valour grow; gains through fire, medicines, forests and royal contact (Saravali 41.25-26)
when well placed: wealth earned through hard work, travel, dealings with rulers, fame, steady devotion to duty (Phaladeepika 19.6)
when weak or afflicted: loss of wealth, anger of rulers, quarrels with kinsmen, distress to the father, trouble at home (BPHS 47.12-15; Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6)
when badly placed: quarrels, sudden anger of the ruler, illness among relatives, wandering, anxiety, fire danger to wealth, children and wife (Phaladeepika 19.5)
rare_outcomes: a high post such as army command through the ruler's favour (BPHS 47.7-11)
kingdom or royal insignia when the Sun is exalted or in the lagna (Saravali 41.54-59)
exile or banishment, punishment from government (BPHS 47.12-15)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] when the Sun is debilitated in the sign but exalted in the navamsa, at the end of the period (Jataka Parijata 18.72)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] in the period of any planet placed in the 8th house (Saravali 41.66-68)

by_area.personality: Courage, effort, intelligence and firmness grow when the Sun is strong (Saravali 41.25-26; Phaladeepika 19.6). When weak: anxiety, harsh temper and a turn to wrong acts (Phaladeepika 19.5; Saravali 41.27-28).
by_area.career: The main theme. Strong Sun: honours and a high post from government, even army command (BPHS 47.7-11); kingdom or leadership of large areas in exaltation, own sign or moolatrikona (Saravali 41.54-59). Weak Sun: punishment or displeasure from authorities, loss of position, humiliation (BPHS 47.12-15; Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6; Saravali 41.70).
by_area.finance: Wealth, produce, clothes and conveyances when strong (BPHS 47.7-11; Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6). Loss of wealth when weak (BPHS 47.12-15); efforts go to waste (Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6). Raman by sign: losses in Virgo, Libra, Capricorn and Aquarius; gains in most other signs (HPA ch. XXIV).
by_area.health: Weak Sun: fever, heart and bile problems, hunger and thirst (Saravali 41.27-28); eye, head and fever trouble when debilitated, eye and face trouble in an enemy sign (Saravali 41.54-59); the whole body suffers when the Sun is in the 8th (Saravali 41.54-59). Ill-health with enemies when weak (Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6).
by_area.relationships: Weak Sun: trouble through wife, children and relatives (Saravali 41.27-28); fire danger to wife and children (Phaladeepika 19.5). Raman: death of the wife with the Sun in Aquarius; enjoyment and friendships in Aries (HPA ch. XXIV).
by_area.family: Distress to the father and to paternal and maternal uncles, opposition from kinsmen, trouble at home when the Sun is weak (BPHS 47.12-15). A son when the Sun is joined with the 5th lord (BPHS 47.9). Jataka Parijata: the father falls ill at the start of the period (18.71).
by_area.spirituality: Righteous conduct with the Sun in Leo; reverence for holy people with the Sun in Taurus; pilgrimages with positional strength (Raman, HPA ch. XXIV). Divine blessings when strong (Uttara Kalamrita 6.5-6).

strengtheners: Sun exalted, moolatrikona or in its own sign (BPHS 47.7; Saravali 41.54-59)
Sun in the lagna, a kendra or the 11th (BPHS 47.7-11); in the lagna gives a kingdom (Saravali 41.54-59)
Sun joined with the 9th or 10th lord, strong in its own vargas (BPHS 47.7-8)
benefic aspect on an otherwise afflicted Sun gives some relief (BPHS 47.15)
Sun as lord of the 8th is not harmed by that lordship (Phaladeepika 20.41)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun debilitated in Libra (BPHS 47.12; Saravali 41.54-59)
Sun weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.12)
Sun joined with malefics, Rahu or Ketu, or with the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.12, Santhanam and Sanskrit gloss)
malefic aspect on the Sun keeps the results bad (BPHS 47.15)
Sun in an enemy sign (Saravali 41.54-59, 41.70)
Sun exalted in the sign but in its debilitation navamsa (Jataka Parijata 18.72)
library_entry.phases: Jataka Parijata 18.71: at the start the father falls ill and expenses are heavy; in the middle everyone in the household, people and animals, has trouble; at the end there is ease and comfort. BPHS 47.3-4: if the Sun is in the first drekkana (0-10 degrees) of its sign its results come at the start of the period, in the second drekkana in the middle, in the third at the end (reversed if retrograde, which the Sun never is). Saravali 41.75 and Phaladeepika 20.33: a planet in a shirshodaya (head-rising) sign gives its results early, in a prishtodaya (hind-rising) sign or debilitated late, in Pisces (both) throughout or in the middle. Jataka Parijata 18.58: for a malefic such as the Sun, its dignity shows at the start, its house in the middle and the aspects on it at the end.
library_entry.disagreements: Phases: Jataka Parijata 18.71 gives a fixed pattern for the Sun's period (father ill and expenses at the start, household trouble in the middle, ease at the end); BPHS 47.3-4 instead times results by the Sun's drekkana; Saravali 41.75 and Phaladeepika 20.33 by whether the sign rises head-first or hind-first. Santhanam's BPHS 47.15 says a benefic aspect gives good 'at times'; the Sanskrit gloss puts that relief in the middle of the period. Raman's sign list makes the Sun in Virgo, Capricorn and Aquarius (signs that are neither enemy nor debilitation for the Sun in BPHS) quite bad, which the BPHS dignity rules do not predict.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as a period about authority, recognition and self-reliance whose tone depends on the Sun's strength. For a weak Sun, advise patience with superiors and government matters, care of health (fever, eyes, heart) and attention to the father's wellbeing. Do not state that a parent, spouse or the native will die; turn maraka lines into advice about caution and health checks.

library_entry.summary: The Moon's ten-year mahadasha is described as a generally pleasant period: peace of mind, comfort, good food, gains of clothes, ornaments, land and cattle, marriage or children, and favour from those in authority. All sources make the outcome depend on the Moon's strength. A strong, waxing or well-placed Moon gives the full good results. A debilitated, waning, afflicted or 6th/8th/12th-house Moon brings loss of money, worry, trouble to the mother and friction with authorities.
common_outcomes: opulence, good fortune, gain of wealth, auspicious functions at home, high position, vehicles, clothes, children and cattle when the Moon is strong and well placed (BPHS 47.16-22)
tranquillity of mind, success in all business, good food, wife and children, ornaments, clothes, gems, cows and lands; honouring Brahmins (Phaladeepika 19.7)
money through sacred prayers, deities, Brahmins and royal favour; women, wealth and lands; flowers, clothes, ornaments and perfumes (Phaladeepika 19.19; Jataka Parijata 18.73)
misunderstandings with wicked people, some loss of money, wind-related illness (Phaladeepika 19.19)
loss of wealth when the Moon is debilitated or waning (BPHS 47.23-26)
rare_outcomes: extraordinary wealth and luxuries when the strong Moon is in the 2nd house (BPHS 47.16-22)
gain of a deposit or hidden treasure and acquisition of learning, with the Moon in the 2nd (BPHS 47.21-22, Sanskrit gloss)
digging tanks and building gardens or public works (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI, tr. P.S. Sastri, p. 144)
unexpected finding of treasure (Raman, Moon in Cancer)
death of the mother (Raman, Moon in Virgo)

by_area.personality: Calm and contented mind when the Moon is strong (Phaladeepika 19.7). With malefics: dullness, mental tension (BPHS 47.23-26); irritability (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI). Waning or descending Moon: mental worry and derangement (Raman).
by_area.career: High position in government, recognition from rulers, success in undertakings (BPHS 47.16-22); success in all business (Phaladeepika 19.7); taking charge of a new office (Raman, Moon in Pisces). Inimical relations with government when a waning Moon is in the 6th, 8th or 12th or with malefics (BPHS 47.23-26); trouble from employees (BPHS 47.23-26).
by_area.finance: Gain of wealth, vehicles, clothes, cattle and land (BPHS 47.16-22; Phaladeepika 19.7, 19.19); wealth that keeps increasing when the Moon is strong (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI). Loss of wealth if the Moon is debilitated, waning or with malefics (BPHS 47.23-26); want of food and loss of money if the Moon is malefic (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); poverty if anything checks the Moon's strength (Jataka Parijata 18.73).
by_area.health: Good health when the Moon is strong. Wind-related disease (Phaladeepika 19.19; Jataka Parijata 18.73); ill health and fevers when the Moon is malefic (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); bodily sluggishness with a weak Moon joined by malefics (BPHS 47.24, Sanskrit gloss).
by_area.relationships: Acquisition of a wife, children and the company of women (Phaladeepika 19.7, 19.19); births of children (BPHS 47.16-22). Troubles to the wife when the Moon is descending from exaltation (Raman).
by_area.family: Auspicious functions at home (BPHS 47.16-22); well-being of the mother when the Moon is strong (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI). Distress to the mother when the Moon is waning, weak or with malefics (BPHS 47.23-26). Quarrels with relatives when the Moon is weak (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); domestic happiness with the Moon in Sagittarius (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and Brahmins, sacred prayers and recitation (Phaladeepika 19.7, 19.19; Jataka Parijata 18.73); visits to holy places with the Moon in Libra or Capricorn and reciting religious texts with the Moon in Pisces (Raman).

strengtheners: Moon exalted (Taurus) or in its own sign (BPHS 47.16-22)
Moon in a kendra or in the 5th, 9th or 11th (BPHS 47.16-22)
Moon joined or aspected by benefics, or full (waxing) and strong (BPHS 47.17, Sanskrit gloss)

Moon owning the 8th house does not spoil the period: the Sun and the Moon give good results even as 8th lords (Phaladeepika 20.41)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated (Scorpio) or waning (BPHS 47.23)
Moon associated with malefics (BPHS 47.24)
waning Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 47.25)
Moon in the last ten days of the lunar month: effects decline gradually (Phaladeepika 19.8)
anything that checks the Moon's strength (Jataka Parijata 18.73)
a natural benefic in debilitation, an enemy's sign or the 6th or 12th gives only untoward results (Phaladeepika 20.27, general rule)
kendra lordship spoils natural benefics; the Moon's blemish is ranked after Jupiter, Venus and Mercury (Phaladeepika 20.50-51)
library_entry.phases: Jataka Parijata 18.83: at the start of the Moon's period come the results of the house the Moon rules over; in the middle, results from the nature of that sign and the Moon's own position; towards the end, results from the planets aspecting the Moon and to the part of the body that house governs. Phaladeepika 20.33 (general rule): a planet in a shirshodaya sign gives its results early in its period, in an ubhayodaya sign in the middle, and in a prishtodaya sign at the end. Frawley (pp. 202-203, general): a benefic period gives seeds at its start and fruit later.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS and Uttara Kalamrita make the whole period good or bad by the Moon's strength and placement. Phaladeepika 19.19 and Jataka Parijata 18.73 give fixed mixed results: comforts together with some loss of money and wind disease. Santhanam reads BPHS 47 as one long list of favourable conditions; the Sanskrit gloss splits it and reads verse 19 as the Moon in the 4th, a placement Santhanam does not mention. In BPHS 47.23 Santhanam gives the Moon in the 3rd 'happiness off and on'; the gloss says a strong Moon there brings wealth and happiness intermittently. Raman's sign results (bad in Virgo and Aquarius, good in Libra and Capricorn) are not found in the BPHS or Phaladeepika chapters read. Phaladeepika 20.41 exempts the Moon from the 8th-lord blemish but 20.50-51 still counts its kendra lordship as a mild blemish.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe this as a period whose tone follows the Moon's condition: comfort, home life and emotional steadiness when the Moon is strong; worry, money strain and concern for the mother when it is weak. Say waxing or waning plainly, as a matter of strength. Do not predict the mother's death or any illness as certain; frame health points as times to rest and look after the body.

library_entry.summary: The Moon's own sub-period opens its mahadasha and lasts about 10 months. Most sources describe it as pleasant: learning, music, good clothes, devotion, the mother's happiness, marriage or a child, and honour. BPHS makes it good when the Moon is exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with the 9th or 10th lord. It turns troubled when the Moon is debilitated, with malefics or in the 6th, 8th or 12th.
common_outcomes: devoted attention to learning, love of music, fine clothes (Jataka Parijata 18.74; Raman p. 240)
birth of a daughter, new clothes, meeting good Brahmins, the mother's wishes fulfilled, marital comfort (Phaladeepika 21.12)
refined company, good health and reputation, journeys to holy places, vehicles and lands, marriage, birth of a child, change of residence (Raman p. 240)
horses, elephants and clothes, devotion to deities and teachers, high position, name and fame when the Moon is well placed (BPHS 53.1-2)
rare_outcomes: acquisition of abandoned wealth; inclination to public life (Raman p. 240)
imprisonment and loss of kinsmen when the Moon is afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6)
danger of drowning when the Moon is in or with the lords of the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 77)

by_area.personality: Devotion to learning and music (Jataka Parijata 18.74; Raman). Lethargy and mental agony when the Moon is afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6).
by_area.career: High position, name and fame when well placed (BPHS 53.1-2); honour from the public and government (Rele). Loss of position and friction with rulers and ministers when afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6); dismissal from service (Rele).
by_area.finance: Horses, elephants, clothes, vehicles and land (BPHS 53.1-2; Raman). Loss of wealth when the Moon is debilitated, with malefics or in a dusthana (BPHS 53.3-6); sudden loss (Rele).
by_area.health: Sound health (Raman). Bodily pain and fear of premature death when the Moon is a maraka or joined with the 8th or 12th lord (BPHS 53.3-6).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or happiness with the spouse; marital comforts (Phaladeepika 21.12; Raman; Rele).
by_area.family: The mother is happy (Phaladeepika 21.12); birth of a daughter (Phaladeepika 21.12) or a child (Raman; Rele). Distress to the mother and loss of kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 53.3-6); death of a brother (Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and teachers and singing hymns (BPHS 53.1-2); meeting good Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.12); journeys to holy places (Raman).

strengtheners: Moon exalted or in its own sign, in a kendra or trikona, or with the 9th or 10th lord (BPHS 53.1-2)
full Moon: full strength, command of an army (BPHS 53.3, Sanskrit gloss)
Moon in the 11th (BPHS 53.1, Sanskrit gloss; Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated, with malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 53.3-6)
Moon lord of the 2nd or 7th, or joined with the 8th or 12th lord (BPHS 53.3-6)
Moon in or with the lords of the 2nd or 7th (Rele)
library_entry.disagreements: Santhanam reads the maraka condition as the Moon lord of the 2nd or 7th, or joined with the 8th or 12th lord; the Sanskrit gloss reads the 2nd/7th lord conjoined with the 8th/12th lord. Santhanam's remedy is a tawny cow, the gloss's a white cow. Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only favourable results, without conditions.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a gentle opening phase, good for study, home life, family events and devotion. Mention the difficult version (money strain, worry, the mother's health) only when the chart shows the listed afflictions, and never predict death.

library_entry.summary: Mars's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 7 months) is mixed. BPHS and Rele make it productive when Mars is in a kendra or trikona or in its exaltation or own sign: fortune, recognition, land and business profit. Phaladeepika and Raman describe heat and friction: bile and blood disorders, fever, fire, quarrels and loss of money. BPHS makes it bad when Mars is in the 6th, 8th or 12th or afflicted by malefics.
common_outcomes: advancement of fortune, recognition by government, clothes and ornaments, success in efforts, more farm output and home prosperity, business profit when Mars is well placed (BPHS 53.7-8)
diseases from bile, fire and impure blood, anxiety, trouble from enemies and thieves, loss of wealth and honour (Phaladeepika 21.13)
quarrels and litigation among friends and relatives, rash ventures, marital disputes, loss of money, trouble from brothers, danger from fever and fire, injury, loss of blood (Raman p. 240)
rare_outcomes: fear of ghosts and disease of household animals (Raman p. 240)
loss of blood through an accident or operation (Rele p. 77)

by_area.personality: Hot temperament when Mars is afflicted (BPHS 53.9-12); rashness and harsh speech (Rele; Raman 'petulance').
by_area.career: Recognition by government and success in efforts (BPHS 53.7-8); honours from the ruler (Rele). Friction with employees and government when Mars is badly placed (BPHS 53.9-12); quarrels with superiors (Rele).
by_area.finance: Business profit and growth in farm output when well placed (BPHS 53.7-8); hard-earned wealth (Rele). Losses in business and farming (BPHS 53.9-12); loss of money (Phaladeepika 21.13; Raman).
by_area.health: Bile, fire and blood disorders (Phaladeepika 21.13); fever, injury, loss of blood (Raman); bodily distress (BPHS 53.9-12).
by_area.relationships: Disputes between husband and wife or lovers (Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from kinsmen (BPHS 53.9-12); trouble from brothers and friends (Raman); separation of brothers (Rele).

strengtheners: Mars in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 53.7-8)
Mars exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 53.7-8; Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 53.9-12)
Mars with or aspected by malefics in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.9-12)
Mars in the 2nd or 7th, or the lord of Mars's sign in the 8th (Rele)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS and Rele give a good version under the listed placements; Phaladeepika and Raman give only troublesome results. Jataka Parijata 18.75 (Mars in the Moon's dasa) is missing from the readable scan and could not be checked. Santhanam gives no remedy; the Sanskrit gloss gives honouring a Brahmin, under a different condition (7th lord in the 2nd, 8th lord in the 8th).
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as an active, energetic short phase: good for property and effort when Mars is well placed, but a time to keep tempers down, avoid disputes and take care with fever, cuts and blood pressure. Do not predict accidents as certain.

library_entry.summary: Rahu's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 6 months) is described as one of the harder parts of the period: enemies, fear of thieves, snakes and authorities, illness in the family, scandal and mental unrest. BPHS gives a better version when Rahu is aspected by benefics, in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th, or with a yogakaraka. It also gives a religious version, pilgrimage and charity, when Rahu is in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon.
common_outcomes: danger from rulers, thieves and snakes, distress to cattle, loss of kin and friends, loss of reputation, mental agony (BPHS 53.13-14)
severe reproach or blame, more enemies, illness of relatives, danger from storms and lightning, fever from bad food or drink (Phaladeepika 21.14)
risk of falls and serious disease, loss of money and relatives, enmity of superiors, trouble through the wife, scandal, skin disease, danger from thieves and poison, danger to parents (Raman p. 241)
rare_outcomes: living in a forest; suffering from hunger (Raman p. 241)
fear of scorpion stings (BPHS 53.17-18)
gain from the king alongside troubles (Rele p. 78)

by_area.personality: Mental agony and anxiety (BPHS 53.13-14; Raman); a religious bent when Rahu is in a kendra or trikona (Rele).
by_area.career: Danger from government (BPHS 53.13-14); enmity of superiors (Raman); loss of position when Rahu is weak in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.17-18); dismissal (Rele). Success and gains of vehicles and clothes from authorities when well placed (BPHS 53.15-16).
by_area.finance: Loss of money (Raman). Gains of vehicles and garments and success in all ventures when Rahu is in an upachaya, aspected by benefics or with a yogakaraka (BPHS 53.15-16).
by_area.health: Fever from bad food and drink (Phaladeepika 21.14); falls, dangerous disease, skin disease, poison (Raman); bodily trouble when Rahu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.19-21).
by_area.relationships: Distress to the wife (BPHS 53.17-18); trouble through the wife (Raman); illness of the wife (Rele).
by_area.family: Loss of kin and friends (BPHS 53.13-14); illness of relatives (Phaladeepika 21.14); distress to children (BPHS 53.17-18); danger to father and mother (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage, visits to shrines and charity when Rahu is in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.19-21); pilgrimage and a religious bent (Rele).

strengtheners: Rahu aspected by benefics (BPHS 53.15-16)
Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th (BPHS 53.15-16; Rele)
Rahu with a yogakaraka (BPHS 53.15-16) or with trine lords (Rele)
Rahu in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.19-21)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu weak and in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.17-18)
Rahu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon, or debilitated (Rele)
Rahu in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.19-21)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 53.13-14: with Rahu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, some good results come at the start of the sub-period and the troubles follow later.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives Rahu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna a poor result (good only at first) but a kendra or trikona from the Moon a religious, favourable one. Phaladeepika and Raman give only troubles. The remedy differs: Santhanam reads Rahu japa, the Sanskrit gloss Rudra japa, both with the gift of a goat. Jataka Parijata 18.76 (Rahu in the Moon's dasa) is missing from the readable scan.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as an unsettled stretch that calls for caution with health, food hygiene, family harmony and dealings with officials. Mention its spiritual side (pilgrimage, charity) where the chart supports it. Avoid frightening language about poison, snakes or danger to parents.

library_entry.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 4 months) is one of the best parts of the period in every source: honour from authorities, celebrations at home, clothes, ornaments, vehicles, land, children, generosity and success. BPHS makes it bad if Jupiter is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, combust, debilitated or with malefics. It warns of premature death if Jupiter is a maraka.
common_outcomes: high position, celebrations at home, clothes and ornaments, recognition, wealth, land and vehicles, success by the ruler's favour (BPHS 53.22-24)
delight in gifts and good deeds, happiness, new clothes and ornaments, meeting friends, high honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.15)
vehicles, plenty of clothing and ornaments, achieving what one strives for (Jataka Parijata 18.77)
more property, plenty of food and comforts, benefits from superiors, birth of a child, patronage of rulers, respect, learning (Raman p. 241)
rare_outcomes: conception by the grace of the chosen deity (BPHS 53.23, Sanskrit gloss)
eating unpalatable food and journeys away from home when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from the Moon (BPHS 53.29-31)

by_area.personality: Generosity and delight in good deeds (Phaladeepika 21.15); valour and patience when Jupiter is in the 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.career: High position and recognition from government (BPHS 53.22-24; Phaladeepika 21.15); benefits from superiors (Raman); favours from government (Rele). Loss of position when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.finance: Wealth, land and vehicles (BPHS 53.22-24); more property (Raman; Rele); cattle, grain and clothes when Jupiter is 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28). Loss of house, vehicles and land when afflicted (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.health: Premature death is warned of when Jupiter is a maraka from the lagna (BPHS 53.29-31); accidental death in the 2nd or 7th (Rele).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or birth of a son (Rele); marriage celebrations when Jupiter is 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28).
by_area.family: Celebrations at home (BPHS 53.22-24); birth of a child (Raman); happiness from brothers (BPHS 53.25-28). Harm to preceptor, father and children when afflicted (BPHS 53.25-28; Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Gifts and charity (Phaladeepika 21.15); oblations and rites (BPHS 53.25-28); favour of the chosen deity (BPHS 53.23).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or in its own or exaltation sign (BPHS 53.22-24)
Jupiter in the 11th (BPHS 53.22, Sanskrit gloss) or the 3rd or 11th (Rele)
Jupiter in the 3rd or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.25-28)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, combust, debilitated or with malefics (BPHS 53.25-28)
Jupiter weak and in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.29-31)
Jupiter as lord of the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 53.29-31)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 53.29-31: good effects at the start of the sub-period and distress towards its end (stated with the weak-Jupiter condition).
library_entry.disagreements: All sources agree the period is generally good. BPHS (Santhanam) puts the weak-Jupiter rule at the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon; the gloss reads the 7th, 4th or 8th, or the 12th. Rele says the 6th, 8th or 11th from the period lord. BPHS ties premature death to Jupiter as lord of the 2nd or 7th; Rele ties accidental death to Jupiter placed in the 2nd or 7th.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a supportive, expansive phase: recognition, family celebrations, generosity and property. Mention the cautions (loss of position, trouble to elders or children) only when the listed afflictions are present, and never predict death.

library_entry.summary: Saturn's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 7 months) is mixed to difficult in most sources. Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman stress illness, the mother's suffering, harsh words and trouble to the spouse. BPHS makes it productive, with a son, friends, property, business through working people and royal favour, when Saturn is in a kendra or trikona, in its own sign or navamsa, exalted or with benefics. Placements in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd bring pilgrimages, trouble from many people and enemies.
common_outcomes: birth of a son, friends, wealth and property, business profit with the help of working people, more farm output, royal favour when Saturn is well placed (BPHS 53.32-34)
visits to holy places and bathing in holy rivers, trouble from many people and enemies when Saturn is in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd or debilitated (BPHS 53.35)
various diseases, sickness of friends, children and wife, a great calamity (Phaladeepika 21.16)
mental anguish from the mother's suffering, wind and bile disorders, harsh words and arguments with unfriendly people (Jataka Parijata 18.78)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] (Phaladeepika 21.16)
the spouse's death or separation (Raman p. 241)
loss of a limb or surgery (Rele p. 79)

by_area.personality: Mental anguish and no peace of mind (Jataka Parijata 18.78; Raman).
by_area.career: Royal favour and business gains through working people when well placed (BPHS 53.32-34); a good time to start a new business (Rele). Dishonour and slander when badly placed (Rele).
by_area.finance: Wealth, property and more farm output when well placed (BPHS 53.32-34); loss of property (Raman).
by_area.health: Many diseases (Phaladeepika 21.16); wind and bile disorders, indigestion (Jataka Parijata 18.78; Raman); physical distress when Saturn is in the 2nd, 7th or 8th (BPHS 53.36-38).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels with the wife at times (BPHS 53.36-38); illness of the wife (Phaladeepika 21.16); the spouse's death or separation (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of a son when well placed (BPHS 53.32-34). Mental trouble due to the mother (Jataka Parijata 18.78; Raman); quarrels with relatives (Raman); disagreement with wife and children (BPHS 53.36-38; Rele).
by_area.spirituality: Visits to holy places and bathing in holy rivers (BPHS 53.35; Rele).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, in its own sign or navamsa, or exalted (BPHS 53.32-34)
Saturn aspected by or with benefics, or strong in the 11th (BPHS 53.32-34)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in the 6th, 8th, 12th or 2nd, or debilitated (BPHS 53.35; Rele)
Saturn in the 2nd, 7th or 8th (BPHS 53.36-38)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS and Rele give a clear good version for a well-placed Saturn; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubles, Phaladeepika up to loss of life and Raman the wife's death or separation. The Sanskrit gloss of verse 36 says harm can come even from a strong Saturn in a kendra or trine; Santhanam reads that verse as mixed results.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as a heavier, work-focused phase: steady effort can bring property and business gains, but rest, digestion, the mother's well-being and patience at home need attention. Do not predict the loss of a spouse or death.

library_entry.summary: Mercury's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 5 months) is described as favourable by nearly every source: wealth, learning and the company of scholars, trade profits, recognition, clothes and ornaments, children, settled disputes and clear thinking. BPHS makes it bad when Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon or debilitated. As a maraka it brings fear of fever.
common_outcomes: wealth, recognition, clothes, scripture discussions, knowledge from learned company, enjoyments, children, satisfaction, business profit, vehicles and ornaments (BPHS 53.39-41)
wealth at all times, elephants, horses, cattle and ornaments, much happiness, clear understanding (Phaladeepika 21.17)
wealth from relatives on the mother's side, learned men seeking one's support, clothes and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.79)
wealth from maternal relatives, new clothes and ornaments, settled disputes, joy through children or a lover, intellectual achievements, new education, honour from rulers (Raman pp. 241-242)
rare_outcomes: addiction to betting and drink (Raman p. 242)
imprisonment when Mercury is in a dusthana from the Moon (BPHS 53.44-46)
drinking soma and other tasty drinks (BPHS 53.42-43)

by_area.personality: Clear understanding (Phaladeepika 21.17); intellectual achievements (Raman); more intellect and contentment (Rele).
by_area.career: Recognition by government (BPHS 53.39-41); close relations with authorities (BPHS 53.42-43); honour from rulers and favours from superiors (Raman; Rele).
by_area.finance: Wealth and business profit (BPHS 53.39-41; Phaladeepika 21.17); gains from trade (Rele); wealth from maternal relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.79; Raman). Loss in farming when afflicted (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.health: Good health (BPHS 53.42-43). Bodily pain when Mercury is in a dusthana from the Moon (BPHS 53.44-46); fear of fever as a maraka (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.relationships: Marriage (BPHS 53.42-43; Rele); pleasure through a lover (Raman). Distress to the wife when afflicted (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.family: Birth of children (BPHS 53.39-41); wealth from the mother's relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.79). Distress to wife and children when afflicted (BPHS 53.44-46).
by_area.spirituality: Discussion of scriptures, company of learned and holy people (BPHS 53.39-41); oblations, charity and religious rites (BPHS 53.42-43).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona, in its own sign or navamsa, exalted, strong (BPHS 53.39-41)
Mercury in a kendra, trikona, the 11th or the 2nd from the Moon (BPHS 53.42-43)
Mercury in the 2nd or 11th from the lagna (Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon, or debilitated (BPHS 53.44-46)
Mercury as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.44-46)
Mercury in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (Rele)
library_entry.disagreements: Broad agreement that the period is good. Raman alone adds betting and drink. The Sanskrit gloss adds the 7th from the dasha lord to the bad positions. BPHS gives fever when Mercury is lord of the 2nd or 7th; Rele when it is placed in the 2nd or 7th.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a good phase for study, trade, writing, settling disputes and family ties on the mother's side. Mention caution with health and family stress only when Mercury is badly placed from the Moon or debilitated.

library_entry.summary: Ketu's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 7 months) is mostly troublesome in Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman: loss of mental balance, money and relatives, illness of the wife, stomach trouble and danger from water. BPHS gives a good version, with wealth, family happiness and religious inclination, when Ketu is strong in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd. It is spoiled when Ketu is in the 8th or 12th from the Moon or with malefics.
common_outcomes: loss of mental balance, wealth and relatives, danger from water, trouble to dependants and servants (Phaladeepika 21.18)
illness of the wife, loss of relatives, stomach diseases, loss of property (Jataka Parijata 18.80)
feverish illness, fire, swellings or eruptions, eye trouble, worry, public criticism, danger to parents and children, scandal, bad company, loss of money and memory (Raman p. 242)
wealth, enjoyment, happiness of wife and children, religious inclination when Ketu is strong and well placed (BPHS 53.47-48)
rare_outcomes: eating prohibited food (Raman p. 242)
engaging in hazardous undertakings (Rele p. 79)
being the cause of one's own undoing (Rele p. 80)

by_area.personality: Loss of mental balance (Phaladeepika 21.18); a mind full of cares and weak memory (Raman).
by_area.career: Public criticism or displeasure and dishonour (Raman; Rele). Obstacles in ventures from enemies when Ketu is badly placed (BPHS 53.50-52).
by_area.finance: Loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.18; Jataka Parijata 18.80). Gain of wealth and cattle when Ketu is strong and well placed from the Moon, with some loss at the end (BPHS 53.49).
by_area.health: Stomach disease (Jataka Parijata 18.80; Raman); fever, fire, eruptions and eye trouble (Raman); bodily disease when Ketu is in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.50-52).
by_area.relationships: Illness of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.80; Raman); happiness with wife and children when well placed (BPHS 53.47-48).
by_area.family: Loss of relatives (Phaladeepika 21.18; Jataka Parijata 18.80); danger to father, mother and children (Raman); trouble to dependants (Phaladeepika 21.18).
by_area.spirituality: Religious inclination and performing rites when Ketu is strong (BPHS 53.47-48).

strengtheners: Ketu strong and in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd from the lagna (BPHS 53.47-48)
Ketu strong and in a kendra, the 5th, 9th or 11th from the Moon (BPHS 53.49)
Ketu in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the lagna or the period lord (Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 8th or 12th from the Moon, or with or aspected by malefics (BPHS 53.50-52)
Ketu in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.50-52; Rele)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 53.47-49 (Santhanam): some loss of wealth at the start, then all well (Ketu well placed from the lagna); loss of wealth at the end (Ketu well placed from the Moon). The Sanskrit gloss of verse 48 reads loss early and happiness in the middle.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS and Rele allow a good version; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubles. On timing, Santhanam says loss at the start then all well (53.48) and loss at the end (53.49); the gloss reads loss early with happiness in the middle. Santhanam does not say from where the 2nd and 7th of verse 51 are counted; the gloss reads them from the dasha lord.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe this as a short, unsettling phase: keep finances careful, watch digestion and fevers, and look after the spouse's health. Note its inward, religious side where Ketu is strong. Do not predict the loss of relatives.

library_entry.summary: Venus's sub-period in the Moon's dasha (about 1 year 8 months) is described mainly as comfortable and prosperous: high position, clothes, ornaments, vehicles, a new house, good food, perfumes, marriage or children, and gains through trade, farming and water-related goods. BPHS makes it bad when Venus is debilitated, combust or afflicted, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon. It warns of premature death when Venus is a maraka.
common_outcomes: high position, clothes, ornaments, cattle and vehicles, happiness of wife and children, a new house, sweet food daily, perfumes, sound health (BPHS 53.53-55)
buying and selling of water-related goods, vehicles, gold, jewels and trade goods; farming; gain of children, friends, cattle and grain (Phaladeepika 21.19)
a dowry on the wife's behalf, comforts from farming, cattle, water products and clothes; possible illness inherited from the mother (Jataka Parijata 18.81)
sudden gains through the wife, good works and meals, birth of children, expenses on marriage or other auspicious events, alongside some sickness and enmity (Raman p. 242)
rare_outcomes: acquisition of hidden treasure when Venus is in the 2nd in exaltation or its own sign (BPHS 53.58-60)
[maraka: text predicts danger to life / death] when Venus is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.62)
fear of drowning when Venus is in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 80)

by_area.personality: Merry and cheerful disposition (Rele).
by_area.career: High position by the ruler's favour (BPHS 53.53-55); gifts and favours from superiors (Rele). Opposition from government when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.finance: Clothes, ornaments, vehicles, cattle, land and houses (BPHS 53.53-61); trade, farming and water-related goods (Phaladeepika 21.19; Jataka Parijata 18.81); gains through the wife (Raman). Loss of land and cattle when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.health: Sound health (BPHS 53.53-56); a disease inherited from the mother (Jataka Parijata 18.81; Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness of the wife, affairs with beautiful women (BPHS 53.53-55); dowry (Jataka Parijata 18.81); love or marriage (Rele). Loss of the wife when Venus is debilitated, combust or afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.family: Happiness of wife and children, a new house (BPHS 53.53-55); birth of a son (BPHS 53.58-60); children, chiefly daughters (Rele). Loss of children when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 53.57).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and Brahmins when Venus is with the 9th or 11th lord (BPHS 53.58-60).

Santhanam reads verse 61 as Venus in a kendra or trikona from the Moon; the gloss adds 'a planet in the 11th from the dasha lord'.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a comfortable, social and home-building phase: marriage, a home, good food, trade and family events. Mention cautions (relationship strain, government friction, illness) only for the afflicted placements, and never predict death or loss of a spouse.

library_entry.summary: The Sun's sub-period closes the Moon's dasha and lasts about 6 months. It is mostly favourable: honour and power from authorities, recovery of lost position or wealth, decline of enemies, end of illness, and a child or the favour of Lakshmi at home. Bile and wind complaints and fever, especially near the end, recur in the sources. BPHS makes it bad when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the Moon.
common_outcomes: recovery of a lost position and wealth, family happiness, villages and land through friends and the ruler, birth of a son, Lakshmi's favour (BPHS 53.65-67)
honour from the ruler, great valour, end of illness, decline of enemies; bile and wind complaints (Phaladeepika 21.20)
power almost regal, freedom from illness, decline of enemies, happiness and prosperity (Jataka Parijata 18.82)

feverish complaints, eye pain, success or failure by the positions of the Sun and Moon, legal power, prosperity, but also jaundice, dropsy, loss of money, travel, danger to parents (Raman pp. 242-243)
rare_outcomes: piles and weakness, loss of children and friends (Raman p. 243)
troubles on foreign journeys (BPHS 53.68-70)

by_area.personality: Great valour (Phaladeepika 21.20); lethargy near the end of the sub-period (BPHS 53.65-67).
by_area.career: Recovery of a lost high position (BPHS 53.65-67; Rele); honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.20); power almost regal (Jataka Parijata 18.82); employment and popularity (Rele). Danger from government when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.68-70); quarrels with men in power (Rele).
by_area.finance: Recovery of wealth, villages and land (BPHS 53.65-67); loss of money (Raman); loss of honour and wealth when afflicted (Rele).
by_area.health: End of illness (Phaladeepika 21.20; Jataka Parijata 18.82). Bile and wind complaints (Phaladeepika 21.20); fever near the end (BPHS 53.65-67); fever as a maraka (BPHS 53.68-70); fever and cough in the 2nd or 7th (Rele).
by_area.family: Happiness in the family, birth of a son (BPHS 53.65-67); possibility of conception (Rele); danger to father and mother (Raman).

strengtheners: Sun exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or 3rd (BPHS 53.65-67; Rele)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun in the 8th or 12th from the Moon (BPHS 53.68-70)
Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the period lord, or with a malefic (Rele)
Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 53.68-70)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 53.65-67: with the Sun well placed, the good results come first; towards the end of the sub-period fever and lethargy are likely.
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and BPHS (well placed) stress honour and recovery; Raman lists both gains and a long set of illnesses and losses. BPHS names the 8th and 12th from the Moon as bad; Rele adds the 6th and malefic association (the gloss also adds malefics). Rele places the 2nd/7th rule on the Sun's position; BPHS on its lordship.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a short closing phase that can restore standing and confidence, with recognition from authorities. Advise rest and care against fevers and digestive heat, especially towards its end. Do not predict danger to parents.

library_entry.summary: Mars's seven-year mahadasha is a period of energy, effort and conflict: income through land, courage, authority, fighting, medicine or fire, alongside quarrels with siblings and family and illness from heat, bile and blood. BPHS makes it strongly favourable (high position, land, wealth, victory over enemies) when Mars is exalted, in its own or moolatrikona sign, or strong in a kendra, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th, and troubled when Mars is debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or afflicted by malefics.
common_outcomes: money made through land, litigation and dealings with rulers; more land and cattle (Phaladeepika 19.20)
wealth through fire, rulers, fighting and the like, and also through medicine, deceit and harsh dealings (Phaladeepika 19.9; Jataka Parijata 18.84)
quarrels with brothers, sons, wife, relatives and elders (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20; Jataka Parijata 18.84)
illness from bile, blood, fever and heat (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20; Jataka Parijata 18.84)
when well placed: land, fulfilled wishes, clarity of mind, courage, money, defeat of enemies, support of younger siblings (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI, p. 144-145)
when strong: high position, recognition from government, wealth and land, gains from abroad, vehicles and ornaments, harmony with siblings (BPHS 47.27-30)
rare_outcomes: rise to a kingdom or command at the head of a large army, when exalted Mars is in the 10th or 11th or in an upward-facing sign (Phaladeepika 20.25)
loss of eyesight or injury to the eye, cuts from weapons, when Mars is unfavourable (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI, p. 145)
mortgaging of landed property and loss of spouse and children for Mars in Libra (Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 245)
having to eat poor, unwholesome food (Jataka Parijata 18.84)

by_area.personality: Courage, effort and clarity of mind when Mars is favourable (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI); a harsher, scheming streak and envy of others' fortune when it is not (Phaladeepika 19.9).
by_area.career: High administrative or political position and government recognition when Mars is strong (BPHS 47.27-30); income through rulers, fighting, the military, medicine or fire (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20); military success and respect for skill for Mars in Capricorn (Raman). Trouble with rulers and superiors when Mars is afflicted (Uttara Kalamrita; Raman for Cancer and Aquarius).
by_area.finance: Wealth through valour, land and property, gains from abroad (BPHS 47.27-31); money through land and litigation, but also loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 19.20); loss of wealth and distress when Mars is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 47.33).
by_area.health: Fevers and illness from bile, blood and heat (Phaladeepika 19.9, 19.20; Jataka Parijata 18.84); wounds, cuts from weapons and eye trouble when Mars is unfavourable (Uttara Kalamrita ch. VI).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from spouse and children when Mars is strong in a kendra or the 3rd (BPHS 47.31-32); quarrels with wife and children and liaisons with low company otherwise (Phaladeepika 19.9; Jataka Parijata 18.84).
by_area.family: Siblings are central: happiness and good relations with co-borns when Mars is strong (BPHS 47.30; Uttara Kalamrita), quarrels with brothers and relatives when it is not (Phaladeepika 19.20; Raman for Cancer, Libra).

strengtheners: Mars exalted, in its moolatrikona or own sign (BPHS 47.27-30)
Mars strong in a kendra, the 11th or the 2nd, in a benefic navamsa, joined or aspected by benefics (BPHS 47.27-30)
Mars strong in a kendra or the 3rd: wealth through valour and victory (BPHS 47.31)
Mars as yogakaraka for Cancer and Leo lagnas, and as 2nd and 9th lord for Pisces lagna (Santhanam's note to BPHS 47.33; Laghu Parashari v. 12)
Mars vargottama (Phaladeepika 20.22)
Mars exalted in the 10th or 11th, or in an upward-facing sign (Phaladeepika 20.25)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 47.33)
a malefic in depression, an enemy sign, the 6th or the 12th gives intense misery in its dasha (Phaladeepika 20.27)
Mars combust (BPHS 47.6, general rule as read in the Sanskrit gloss; Phaladeepika 20.22: mixed results)
Mars's dasha falling fifth in the sequence from birth is called dangerous (Phaladeepika 20.24)
Mars in Cancer, Libra or Aquarius (Raman, ch. XXIV)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 47.32: when Mars is strong in a kendra or the 3rd, some unfavourable effects come at the end of the dasha (the Sanskrit gloss: happiness at the start, trouble at the end). BPHS 47.3-4: a planet in the first decanate of its sign gives its results at the start of the dasha, the second in the middle, the third at the end; the order reverses if the planet is retrograde. Phaladeepika 20.57: a weak Mars in an auspicious sign or navamsa gives its good results in the latter half.
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata describe the dasha mostly in mixed or harsh terms (gains through land and fighting, but quarrels and bile/blood illness), while BPHS makes it strongly good or bad depending on dignity and house. Santhanam's BPHS 47.32 says the strong-Mars dasha has some unfavourable effects at its end; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as happiness at the start and trouble at the end. Santhanam lists the favourable houses as kendra, 11th and 2nd; the gloss adds trikona. Raman makes Cancer (debilitation) and also Libra and Aquarius bad signs, but Santhanam's note makes Mars a yogakaraka for Cancer lagna, so sign and functional role can pull in opposite directions.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as a high-energy, effort-driven period: good for property, initiative, competition and courage, with a need to manage temper, disputes (especially with siblings and family) and heat-related health. Stress the favourable version only when the chart shows a strong or yogakaraka Mars. Do not predict deaths, accidents or surgery; at most suggest care with health, safety and conflict.

library_entry.summary: Mars's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 4 months 27 days) is described by Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman as heated and quarrelsome: illness from heat and bile, wounds, friction with siblings and friends, trouble from rulers. BPHS makes it good (royal favour, recovery of lost position and wealth, property, a son) when Mars is in a kendra, trikona, the 2nd, 3rd or 11th, or exalted or in its own sign.
common_outcomes: illness from bile and heat, wounds, separation from brothers, money from land and litigation, trouble from cousins, fire, enemies, rulers and thieves (Phaladeepika 21.21)
great heat, dislike of friends, annoyance from brothers, danger from a ruler, failure of undertakings (Jataka Parijata 18.85)
the same, plus quarrels with relatives, loss of money, skin trouble, loss of blood, boils and anal fissures (Raman, pp. 245-246)
rare_outcomes: recovery of a lost kingdom or high position (BPHS 54.1-2)
anxiety through foreigners or warlike people, open violence (Raman, p. 246)

by_area.personality: Heat of temper and dislike of friends (Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).
by_area.career: Royal or government favour and reinstatement in position when Mars is well placed (BPHS 54.1-4); danger from rulers and failure of undertakings otherwise (Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, house, land and cattle when well placed (BPHS 54.1-4); money from land and litigation (Phaladeepika 21.21); loss of money (Raman).
by_area.health: Bile and heat disorders, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.21); urinary trouble and wounds when Mars is in the 8th or 12th or afflicted (BPHS 54.5); mental agony and bodily pain if Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.6).
by_area.relationships: Birth of a son when Mars is well placed (BPHS 54.1-3).
by_area.family: Separation from or annoyance with brothers (Phaladeepika 21.21; Jataka Parijata 18.85; Raman).

strengtheners: Mars in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th, 3rd or 2nd, or joined with the lagna lord (BPHS 54.1-2)
Mars exalted, in its own sign or own navamsa, with strength (BPHS 54.3-4)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 54.5)
Mars as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.6)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS makes this sub-period clearly good under the listed houses and dignities; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give mostly troublesome results without conditions, though Phaladeepika also gives money from land. Santhanam and the Sanskrit gloss differ on verse 6 (2nd or 7th lord vs the 7th lord in the 2nd) and on the colour of the bull.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe a hot, driven start to the Mars period: advise patience with siblings and colleagues, care against injuries and heat-related illness, and prudence with officials. Mention property gains and recognition only when the chart shows the favourable placements.

library_entry.summary: Rahu's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 18 days) is one of the hardest in every source: danger from rulers, thieves, weapons, fire and poison, loss of wealth and of relatives, illness, even imprisonment. BPHS allows good results (honours, property, business profit, pilgrimage, foreign travel) when Rahu is exalted or in moolatrikona, or in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with benefics.
common_outcomes: danger from weapons, fire, thieves, enemies and rulers, poison, disease of belly, eyes and head, loss of elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.22)
peril from rulers and robbers, loss of wealth and grain, success in wrong pursuits (Jataka Parijata 18.86)
danger from rulers and robbers, loss of wealth, poisoning, loss of relatives, skin disease, change of residence, scandal, loss of cattle, fear of insects and thieves, imprisonment (Raman, p. 246)
rare_outcomes: bathing in holy rivers like the Ganges, foreign journeys, extraordinary business profit (BPHS 54.9-10)
falls into a well, famine, fear of ghosts, gonorrhoea (Raman, p. 246)

by_area.personality: Loss of memory and fretting (Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from government when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 54.9-10); danger from rulers and imprisonment otherwise (BPHS 54.11-12; Jataka Parijata 18.86).
by_area.finance: Extraordinary business profit, house and land when well placed (BPHS 54.9-10); loss of wealth in the 2nd (BPHS 54.13) and in general (Jataka Parijata; Raman).
by_area.health: Wounds, vata and pitta disorders (BPHS 54.12); poison, belly, eye and head disease (Phaladeepika 21.22); skin disease (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from a son and gain of a wife when well placed (BPHS 54.10); great danger in the 7th (BPHS 54.13).
by_area.family: Loss of elders and relatives (Phaladeepika 21.22; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Pilgrimage and bathing in holy rivers when well placed (BPHS 54.10).

strengtheners: Rahu exalted or in moolatrikona, or in a kendra, the 5th, 9th or 11th, with benefics (BPHS 54.9-10)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 8th or 12th, or joined or aspected by malefics (BPHS 54.11-12)
Rahu in the 2nd (loss of wealth) or the 7th (danger to life) (BPHS 54.13)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives a favourable version under specific placements; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troublesome results. Santhanam reads the favourable condition as placement 'and associated with benefics'; the Sanskrit gloss lists the placements and benefic contact as alternatives.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present as a period calling for caution: legal matters, safety while travelling, health checks, and care with money and with people of doubtful intent. Mention the favourable version only when Rahu is well placed. Do not predict death, poisoning or imprisonment.

library_entry.summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is a good part of the period in most sources: religious activity, honours, wealth, property, health and children. BPHS spoils it when Jupiter is in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust, afflicted or weak, and warns of danger when Jupiter rules the 2nd (or 7th).
common_outcomes: worship of Brahmins and gods, visits to holy places, meritorious acts, hospitality, new children and friends (Phaladeepika 21.23)
wealth and land through Brahmins, freedom from illness, public esteem, ascendancy and happiness (Jataka Parijata 18.87)
end of the unfortunate time, favour from superiors, money, birth of children, wealth through holy people (Raman, pp. 246-247)
rare_outcomes: severe ear disease or phlegm complaints (Phaladeepika 21.23)
trouble from spirits, loss of servants and siblings when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.20-22)

by_area.career: Honours from government, success in business (BPHS 54.15-19); favour from superiors (Raman); wrath of rulers if Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.20-21).
by_area.finance: Increase of wealth, grain, property, cattle (BPHS 54.15-19); wealth and land through Brahmins (Jataka Parijata 18.87).
by_area.health: Sound health (BPHS 54.19; Jataka Parijata 18.87); ear and phlegm complaints (Phaladeepika 21.23); bile disease when afflicted (BPHS 54.21); fever if Jupiter rules the 2nd (BPHS 54.22).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 54.16, 54.19); new children (Phaladeepika 21.23; Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness at home (BPHS 54.16); loss of siblings when Jupiter is afflicted (BPHS 54.22).
by_area.spirituality: Worship, pilgrimage to holy places and meritorious deeds (Phaladeepika 21.23).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra, the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from the lagna, or in its exalted or own navamsa (BPHS 54.15-16)
Jupiter in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Mars, or with the lords of the 9th, 10th, 4th or lagna (BPHS 54.17-19)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th, debilitated, combust, with or aspected by malefics, or weak (BPHS 54.20-21)
Jupiter as lord of the 2nd (Santhanam) or 2nd/7th (gloss) (BPHS 54.22)
library_entry.disagreements: Santhanam's OCR reads the bad houses as 5th, 8th, 12th; the Sanskrit gloss gives 6th, 8th, 12th (used here). Santhanam names the 2nd lord only; the gloss names the lord of the 2nd and 7th. Uttara Kalamrita promises raja yoga from strong Mars and Jupiter; its translator disagrees from experience.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe as a welcome easing within the Mars period: support from mentors, family happiness, devotion, property. If Jupiter is afflicted, advise care with health and officials without forecasting danger to life.

library_entry.summary: Saturn's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is the most dreaded of the period: illness, loss of wealth and property, trouble from rulers, thieves and enemies, distress to family. BPHS gives a good version (honours, wealth, children) when Saturn is in a kendra, trikona, its own sign or moolatrikona, or with benefics, but unusually makes Saturn's good position from Mars bad.
common_outcomes: trouble after trouble to children, wife and elders, grief, loss and theft of wealth, illness from heat and wind (Phaladeepika 21.24)
illness bringing much misery, threats from enemies, robbers and rulers, loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.88)
loss of money, illness, loss of relatives, danger from weapons or surgery, litigation, loss of property and position (Raman, p. 247)
rare_outcomes: results falling on Saturdays and in Saturn's month (BPHS 54.25)
defeat in battle and loss from selling farm land (BPHS 54.30-32)

by_area.personality: Mental agony (BPHS 54.27-32); violent or wrongful acts and ill repute when Saturn is in a kendra, 5th or 11th from Mars (BPHS 54.30-31).
by_area.career: Royal recognition and fame when Saturn is well placed (BPHS 54.23-25); loss of position, punishment by rulers, imprisonment otherwise (BPHS 54.26-32; Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth and grain when well placed (BPHS 54.24); loss of wealth, farm produce and land otherwise (BPHS 54.26, 54.32; Phaladeepika 21.24; Jataka Parijata 18.88).
by_area.health: Disease (BPHS 54.26); urinary trouble (BPHS 54.32); rheumatism and pains (BPHS 54.33-34); heat and wind illness (Phaladeepika 21.24).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children (BPHS 54.29; Phaladeepika 21.24).
by_area.family: Children and grandchildren when well placed (BPHS 54.25); loss of siblings and family quarrels otherwise (BPHS 54.28-29).

strengtheners: Saturn in a kendra or trikona, its own sign or moolatrikona, an exalted or own navamsa, or with the lagna lord or benefics (BPHS 54.23-25)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn debilitated or in an enemy sign, or in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 54.26)
Saturn as 2nd or 7th lord with malefics (BPHS 54.27-29)
Saturn in a kendra, the 5th or 11th from Mars (BPHS 54.30-32)
Saturn in the 8th or 12th from Mars with malefics (BPHS 54.33-34)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS's rule that Saturn well placed from Mars (kendra, 5th, 11th) gives bad results reverses the usual principle; Santhanam flags this. Santhanam lists kendra, 11th and 5th from Mars; the gloss reads kendra, 11th or trikona. Uttara Kalamrita's results-exchange rule makes the sub-period reflect Mars's own condition, which the other texts do not say.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Treat as a demanding stretch that rewards caution: avoid conflicts with authorities, review legal and property matters, look after health and family. Mention the favourable version only when Saturn is well placed from the lagna. Never predict death or imprisonment.

library_entry.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 11 months 27 days) is mixed. BPHS gives religious and diplomatic activity, authority, vehicles and success in farming when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, and very high results when it is in a kendra or trikona from Mars; the other texts and Raman stress enemies, thieves and worry alongside trade gains.
common_outcomes: fear of enemies, trouble from thieves, loss of wealth, loss of cattle and horses, harassment by rulers (Phaladeepika 21.25)
wealth from traders, plenty of houses, cattle and grain, trouble from enemies and mental worry (Jataka Parijata 18.89)
marriage or inclination to it, knowledge, wealth through trade, trouble from enemies, worry, success in litigation (Raman, p. 247)
rare_outcomes: command of an army, music, discussions on scripture (BPHS 54.41-43)
poisoning by insects or animals (Raman, p. 247)

by_area.personality: Inclination to diplomacy and fame (BPHS 54.36-37); harsh speech and sinful thinking when Mercury is badly placed from Mars (BPHS 54.44-45).
by_area.career: Authority in government service (BPHS 54.37); high position and command (BPHS 54.41-43); antagonism with government when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40).
by_area.finance: Gains from trade, houses, cattle and grain (Jataka Parijata 18.89; Raman); loss of wealth and cattle (Phaladeepika 21.25; BPHS 54.38-39).
by_area.health: Heart disease when Mercury is debilitated, combust or in a dusthana (BPHS 54.38-39); many ailments when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40); critical illness if Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.46).
by_area.relationships: Marriage or wish to marry (Raman); distress to wife and children when Mercury is badly placed (BPHS 54.38-39).
by_area.family: Quarrels with kinsmen when joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40); loss of kinsmen (BPHS 54.39).
by_area.spirituality: Company of holy people, japa, charity and religious rites (BPHS 54.36); discussion of scriptures and Puranas (BPHS 54.43).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 54.36-37)
Mercury in a kendra, trikona or exalted, from Mars (BPHS 54.41-43)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 54.38-39)
Mercury joined with Mars (BPHS 54.40)
Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars or with malefics (BPHS 54.44-45)
Mercury as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 54.46)
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika gives only adverse results; Jataka Parijata and Raman mix trade gains with enemies and worry; BPHS turns on placement. Santhanam and the gloss differ on whether verse 44 refers to Mercury or the dasha lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: A mixed sub-period: good for trade, study, negotiation and settling disputes, with a need to guard against rivals, careless speech and travel risks. Advise attention to heart and general health only when the chart shows the afflicted conditions.

library_entry.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is turbulent in Phaladeepika and Raman: sudden danger from fire and weapons, quarrels, trouble from relatives and low people, possible departure from home. BPHS gives royal favour, wealth, land and a son when Ketu is in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or with benefics.
common_outcomes: danger from lightning, sudden trouble from fire and weapons, leaving one's country or loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.26)
opposition of bad people (Jataka Parijata 18.90, partly illegible in the scan)
quarrels with low people, loss of money, sins, trouble from relatives and brothers, family disputes, poisonous complaints, trouble through women, many enemies (Raman, pp. 247-248)
rare_outcomes: command of an army and friendship with rulers when Ketu is a strong yogakaraka (BPHS 54.50-51)
tooth trouble, dysentery, leprosy, distress from tigers (BPHS 54.52-53)

by_area.career: Government favour and authority when Ketu is well placed (BPHS 54.48-49); generalship and friendship with officials if Ketu is a yogakaraka (BPHS 54.50-51).
by_area.finance: Wealth, a little land early and more later (BPHS 54.49); loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.26; Raman; BPHS 54.54).
by_area.health: Fever, dysentery, tooth trouble when Ketu is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.52-53); disease in the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.54).
by_area.relationships: Distress to wife and children (BPHS 54.53); trouble through women (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of a son when well placed (BPHS 54.49); disputes with relatives and brothers (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Performance of oblations when Ketu is a yogakaraka (BPHS 54.51).

strengtheners: Ketu in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th, or with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 54.48-49)
Ketu a yogakaraka (joined with one) and strong (BPHS 54.50-51)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.52-53)
Ketu in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 54.54)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 54.49: when Ketu is well placed, only small gains of land at the start of the sub-period and substantial gains later.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives a favourable version for good placements; Phaladeepika and Raman give only adverse results. Santhanam reads verse 52 as Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars; the Sanskrit gloss garbles it.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Short and unsettled: advise care with fire, sharp tools, travel and family disputes. Mention the favourable version when Ketu is well placed. Do not predict the death of the native or spouse.
