library_entry.summary: Venus's sub-period in Mars's dasha (about 1 year 2 months) brings comforts, money from relatives, jewels and clothes, and in BPHS high position and luxury when Venus is in a kendra, exalted, in its own sign or a trikona lord. Phaladeepika is harsher (defeat, residence abroad, theft, eye trouble), and BPHS gives losses when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars.
common_outcomes: jewels for the wife, clothes, money from relatives, but odium of women and their company (Jataka Parijata 18.91)
property or money, domestic happiness, love affairs, festivities, travel pleasure, skin eruptions (Raman, p. 248)
defeat in battle, residence abroad, theft, left-eye trouble, loss of servants (Phaladeepika 21.27)
rare_outcomes: construction of wells and reservoirs and charitable works when Venus is linked to the 10th lord (BPHS 54.60)
elephants and horses (BPHS 54.55-56)

by_area.personality: Increase of intelligence (Raman).
by_area.career: High position in government (BPHS 54.55-56); gains from the employer (BPHS 54.57-58).
by_area.finance: Property, money from relatives, houses, land and villages by official favour (BPHS 54.57-59; Jataka Parijata 18.91); loss of wealth when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars (BPHS 54.61-62).
by_area.health: Skin eruptions and boils (Raman); bodily pain if Venus rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.63); left-eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.27).
by_area.relationships: Happiness of wife and children and good fortune when Venus is linked to the lagna lord (BPHS 54.56); love affairs and gifts to the wife (Raman; Jataka Parijata 18.91); disrepute through women (Jataka Parijata 18.91).
by_area.family: Celebrations of a son's birth (BPHS 54.57); dissensions in the family when badly placed (BPHS 54.62).
by_area.spirituality: Holy bathing, religious and charitable works (BPHS 54.59-60); religious observances (Raman).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, exalted, in its own sign, or lord of the 1st, 5th or 9th (BPHS 54.55-56)
Venus in the 5th, 9th, 11th or 2nd from Mars (BPHS 54.57-58)
Venus linked to the lagna lord or the 10th lord (BPHS 54.56, 54.60)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mars, or with malefics (BPHS 54.61-62)
Venus as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 54.63)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 54.59: when Venus is well placed from Mars, the last part of the sub-period brings music and dance and bathing in holy waters.
library_entry.disagreements: Phaladeepika gives a hard version (defeat, exile, theft) where BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Raman are mostly favourable. Santhanam and the gloss differ on the houses from the lagna and from Mars, and on the colour of the donated cow.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Generally a pleasant interval: comforts, relationships, family celebrations, property and charity. Advise care with reputation in relationships and with eye and skin health where the chart is weak.

placement_entries.summary: The Sun in the 12th is classically weak: loss of standing, strained ties with the father, weak eyes and little wealth. Some texts still give energy and sons, and modern writers stress retreat, foreign work and spiritual life.
common_outcomes: Fall in standing or feeling neglected (Brihat Jataka 20.3; Raman)
Weak eyesight (Phaladeepika 8.4; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Little wealth or lack of success (Phaladeepika 8.4, Raman)
Energetic and has sons (Jataka Parijata 8.97; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
rare_outcomes: Hostility toward the father (Phaladeepika 8.4)
Becomes an apostate and a wanderer (Jataka Parijata 8.97)
Loss of a limb, or a 'maimed' body (Jataka Parijata 8.97; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Love of esoteric and occult knowledge, ritual-minded (Raman HPA)

by_area.personality: Energetic (Jataka Parijata 8.97); Raman HPA lists sinful or adulterous tendencies.
by_area.career: Works out of the spotlight: research, hospitals, ashrams, foreign postings (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Poor (Phaladeepika 8.4, Raman HPA).
by_area.health: Weak eyes (Phaladeepika 8.4, Raman).
by_area.family: Hostile to father (Phaladeepika 8.4); has sons (Jataka Parijata 8.97) though Phaladeepika gives no sons and Raman HPA no happiness from children.
by_area.spirituality: Esoteric and occult interest (Raman HPA); read as release, retreat and moksha (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Satyacharya: malefics in the 12th favour fortune; Bhattotpala: benefics there reduce expenditure (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes)
A strong Jupiter aspect on the Sun in the 12th made the native spiritual in one of Raman's case studies (How to Judge a Horoscope, Twelfth House, Chart 247)
placement_entries.disagreements: On children Phaladeepika says none, Jataka Parijata and Raman's How to Judge a Horoscope say sons. Classical texts are negative about status and wealth; PanchangBodh and VedicFeed read it as a placement of quiet, foreign or spiritual work and even growth.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a person who may shine behind the scenes, abroad or in service and spiritual settings. Avoid moral judgements, and do not predict loss of limbs, poverty or a broken bond with the father.

placement_entries.summary: The Sun in Cancer is in the Moon's sign, a friend, but the watery, emotional sign tempers the Sun's steadiness. Texts give mixed results: honour and good qualities alongside unsteady undertakings, hard work for others and tension with relatives.
common_outcomes: Unsteady in undertakings (Saravali 22.26-27)
Works hard, often on behalf of others
Fluctuating projects or plans
Recognition for virtue, eloquence or public service
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka describes a hot-tempered, poor person who faces hardship and an austere path
Saravali 22.26-27 describes royal qualities and fame, but strain with paternal relatives and an unattractive spouse
Saravali 22.26-27 mentions study of geography or atmospheric sciences and a liking for intoxicants

by_area.personality: Unsteady in undertakings yet honourable and eloquent (Saravali 22.26-27); hot-tempered (Brihat Jataka 18.2); Raman HPA ch. XXII lists indolence, sorrow and a servile mentality.
by_area.career: Works for others (Brihat Jataka 18.2); famed for royal qualities, studies geography and the sky (Saravali 22.26-27); Raman: travelling.
by_area.finance: Brihat Jataka 18.2 and Raman say poor; Saravali 22.26-27 does not stress poverty.
by_area.health: Saravali 22.26-27 links the placement to phlegm-bile imbalance and fatigue from hard labour, and Raman lists sickliness; mention only as a traditional tendency.
by_area.relationships: Saravali 22.26-27 notes an unattractive or difficult spouse; treat cautiously and confirm from the 7th.
by_area.family: Saravali 22.26-27: hates his own people and those on the paternal side.
by_area.spirituality: Brihat Jataka 18.2 speaks of hardship on an austere path; Saravali 22.26-27: follows virtuous principles.

strengtheners: Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 22.28-33: pre-eminence) or Moon's aspect (Saravali 22.28-33: high status and water-based trade)
Mercury's aspect (Saravali 22.28-33: learning and honour)
Venus's aspect (Saravali 22.28-33: wealth through spouse)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars's aspect (Saravali 22.28-33: lung trouble and slander)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 22.28-33: phlegm and wind disorders)
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka is clearly unfavourable (temper, poverty, labour for others); Saravali is mixed with notable honour and virtue. Both agree on effort, strain and some family friction.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Say this placement mixes sensitivity and service with pride; results depend strongly on the Moon. Avoid stating poverty or a bad marriage as fact.
sources: Brihat Jataka 18.2 (tr. M. D. Neely, 2007)

placement_entries.summary: The Moon in the 4th is one of its best placements: happiness, home, vehicles, friends and a strong bond with the mother. Its directional strength lies here.
common_outcomes: Happy and contented (Phaladeepika 8.6, Brihat Jataka 20.4, Raman)
Vehicles, friends and renown (Phaladeepika 8.6)
Owns a house; happiness from relatives (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Fine tastes, polite manners, well educated (Raman HPA)
rare_outcomes: Desires other people's spouses (Jataka Parijata 8.68)
Becomes a leader; proud and somewhat quarrelsome (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Contented, generous, pleasure-loving (Phaladeepika 8.6); good nature and learning (Jataka Parijata 8.68).
by_area.career: May become important as a leader (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.finance: Wealthy and successful (Raman HPA); prosperity (Jataka Parijata 8.68).
by_area.relationships: Raman lists sensual pleasures unless Jupiter aspects.
by_area.family: Home, mother, land and vehicles matter greatly (PanchangBodh); a good mother (Raman HPA).

strengtheners: Directional strength (digbala) in the 4th; a waxing Moon here is among the steadiest placements (PanchangBodh)
Jupiter's aspect restrains sensual excess (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Afflicted Moon: early separation from the mother (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); with malefics, early loss of the mother (Raman HPA)
The 'karaka bhava nashaya' maxim (significator in its own house harms it) is later than Parashara and matters mainly for a waning or afflicted Moon (PanchangBodh)
placement_entries.disagreements: Broad agreement on happiness and home. Jataka Parijata and Raman HPA add a sensual or roving streak not found in Phaladeepika or Brihat Jataka. PanchangBodh rejects a strong 'karaka in own house' penalty.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak warmly of home, comfort and family support. Do not mention a parent's early loss.

placement_entries.summary: The Moon is debilitated in Scorpio (deepest fall at 3°), the sign of Mars. It gives intense, private, guarded emotions and resilience under pressure; classical texts are harsh, while modern practitioners stress depth, investigative skill and transformation, and note that cancellation is common.
common_outcomes: Intense, private emotions; slow to trust
Strong will and endurance under pressure
Industrious and skilled
Early-life challenges or separations
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 17.8 and Phaladeepika 9.8: separation from father or teacher in childhood
Brihat Jataka 17.8: from a respected family with authority; honoured by rulers (Phaladeepika 9.8)
Saravali 23.51: loss of wealth through the anger of authorities

by_area.personality: Classical texts list harshness and concealed faults (Brihat Jataka 17.8; Saravali 23.51); Raman HPA ch. XXII: straightforward, frank and open-minded yet obstinate and impetuous. Frawley (p. 126): with the debility cancelled it can give a very deep understanding of the psyche. Read the harsh items as shadow tendencies, not verdicts.
by_area.career: Industrious and skilful (Saravali 23.51); Frawley (p. 126) says a cancelled Moon in Scorpio is common among spiritual teachers, occultists and psychologists.
by_area.finance: Saravali 23.51: losses through the wrath of authorities; Phaladeepika 9.8: honoured by rulers; Raman: wealthy.
by_area.health: Texts mention illness in early life (Brihat Jataka 17.8; Saravali 23.51); present only as a traditional note, never as a prediction.
by_area.relationships: Saravali 23.51 lists attraction to others' partners and Raman agitation and unhappiness; handle gently.
by_area.family: Separation from father or teacher in youth (Brihat Jataka 17.8; Phaladeepika 9.8); Raman: isolation from parents or preceptors.
by_area.spirituality: Frawley (p. 126): common in spiritual teachers and occultists when the debility is cancelled.

strengtheners: Neecha bhanga: Mars (sign lord) or Venus (lord of Taurus, the exaltation sign) in a kendra from lagna or Moon (Phaladeepika 7.26, 7.29)
Mars and Venus in mutual kendras (Phaladeepika 7.27)
Mars aspecting the Moon from a good house (Phaladeepika 7.28; Saravali 23.52-57: incomparable courage, king-like, unconquerable)
Mars exalted in Capricorn can cancel the debility, and Mars strong or in Aries reduces it (Frawley p. 126; Braha, 'Yogas' no. 13)
Placement in an angle from lagna or Moon, the 10th most of all; usually two cancelling factors are needed (Frawley p. 126)
An exalted planet joining the Moon (Braha, 'Yogas' no. 13)
Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 23.52-57: dutiful, wealthy, beautiful; modern practitioners treat it as a key support)
Bright (waxing, well-lit) Moon, which Braha (pp. 19-20) treats as benefic and stronger
weakeners_or_cancellations: Within a few degrees of 3 degrees Scorpio, the deepest fall (BPHS 3.49-50)
Waning or dim Moon, which Braha (pp. 19-20) treats as malefic and weaker
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 23.52-57: base sons, sickness, poverty)
Mercury's aspect (Saravali 23.52-57: trickery, harsh speech)
Placement in a dusthana (6th, 8th, 12th); Braha (pp. 51-52) says a planet there is spoiled, the 6th being the mildest
Vargottama does not help a fallen planet; Braha (pp. 13, 59) says it leaves it worse off
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical verses are mostly unfavourable, yet Brihat Jataka and Phaladeepika also mention a respected family or royal honour. Modern practitioners give a more psychological, growth-oriented reading. Commentators differ on whether the 'exaltation lord' for cancellation is Venus (lord of Taurus) or the planet exalted in Scorpio (none in the standard scheme). Braha reads the fallen Moon harshly in every house, while Frawley says cancellation is possible and a cancelled Moon in Scorpio gives psychological depth; Frawley's angle rule and Braha's angle readings conflict directly for the 1st, 4th, 7th and 10th houses. BPHS treats all of Scorpio as debilitation, while Braha (p. 47) says that past 3 degrees the Moon is technically no longer fallen.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Never call the person cruel or secretive. Say the emotional nature is deep and protective, and that supports in the chart (cancellation, Jupiter) matter a lot. No health or parental-loss predictions.

placement_entries.summary: Mars in the 12th is read as a draining placement: losses and expenses, trouble in marriage, heat-related ailments, eye trouble and exposure to deception. It is a Kuja dosha house.
common_outcomes: Loss of money or lack of wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.97; Raman)
Trouble or loss in marriage (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.97; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Defective eyes (Phaladeepika 8.10; Raman HPA)
Liable to fraud and deception (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Slanderous, cruel or base (Phaladeepika 8.10)
Diseases from excess bodily heat (Raman)
Work abroad, in institutions, or disciplined spiritual practice (PanchangBodh)

by_area.personality: Selfish and hateful (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); odious to others (Jataka Parijata 8.97).
by_area.career: Unsuccessful (Raman HPA); suits work abroad and institutional settings (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Without wealth (Jataka Parijata 8.97); energy and money spent in distant or unseen places such as travel, legal or medical costs (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Heat-related ailments (Raman); restless sleep (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Classical texts give loss of or no spouse (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.97); malefics in the 7th and 8th with Mars here suggest a second marriage (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.spirituality: Disciplined spiritual practice suits it (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Kuja dosha does not arise when the 12th is Taurus or Libra, or when Mars is in Leo or Aquarius (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Conjunction with Jupiter or the Moon counters Kuja dosha (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Aspected by the Sun: danger from fire and wicked people (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Mars in the 12th, Saturn in the 2nd, Moon in the lagna and Sun in the 7th: a skin disorder (leucoderma) (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
placement_entries.disagreements: VedicFeed reads it as kind and peaceful, against the uniformly negative classics and Raman. PanchangBodh frames the 12th as a place for foreign work and spiritual discipline rather than mere loss.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as energy that works best behind the scenes, abroad or in disciplined practice; advise budgeting and care with trust in money matters. Do not predict loss of a spouse, and keep health notes general.

placement_entries.summary: Mars is debilitated in Cancer (deepest fall at 28°), though Cancer's lord, the Moon, is a friend. The fiery planet in a watery sign gives emotional reactivity, indirect assertion and unsettled living conditions, yet texts also give prosperity through water-related work; neecha bhanga is frequently present.
common_outcomes: Repeated distress and anguish (Saravali 25.7-8); bold and headlong (Raman HPA ch. XXII)
Unsettled home life or living in others' homes
Effort with recurring frustration
Gains through agriculture, water or shipping
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.6: prosperous through water-borne trade, wise, possibly physically impaired
Saravali 25.7-8: enjoys royal food and robes in childhood; eats in others' homes

by_area.personality: Repeatedly anguished and distressed (Saravali 25.7-8); wise (Brihat Jataka 18.6); bold, dashing, speculative, fickle and egoistic (Raman HPA ch. XXII). Frawley (p. 126): with the debility cancelled it can give mastery over the feeling nature and a capacity for profound relationships.
by_area.career: Agriculture and water-borne trade (Brihat Jataka 18.6; Saravali 25.7-8); Raman: love of agriculture, medical and surgical proficiency, travels and voyages.
by_area.finance: Wealth through water or farming despite distress (Brihat Jataka 18.6; Saravali 25.7-8); Raman: wealthy.
by_area.health: Texts mention illness and bodily impairment (Saravali 25.7-8; Brihat Jataka 18.6) and Raman defective sight; never present as a prediction.
by_area.family: Lives and eats in others' houses (Saravali 25.7-8).

strengtheners: Neecha bhanga: Moon (sign lord) or Saturn (lord of Capricorn, Mars's exaltation sign) in a kendra from lagna or Moon (Phaladeepika 7.26, 7.29)
Moon and Saturn in mutual kendras (Phaladeepika 7.27)
Moon aspecting Mars from a good house (Phaladeepika 7.28)
Jupiter (exalted in Cancer) in a kendra or aspecting or joining Mars (modern practitioner rule, jagannathhora.com; Braha, 'Yogas' no. 13)
Strong Moon as sign lord: Frawley (p. 126) says a strong or own-sign dispositor reduces debility and an exalted one (Moon in Taurus) can cancel it
The Sun exalted in Aries, a sign Mars rules, reduces the weakness (Frawley p. 126)
Placement in an angle from lagna or Moon, the 10th most of all; usually two cancelling factors are needed (Frawley p. 126)
Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 25.43-48: famous, royal minister, learned, charitable)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 25.43-48: wealth through water journeys, king-like)
Placement in the 10th, where Mars has directional strength (Braha pp. 23, 60; Foss, Mars name 12)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Near 28 degrees Cancer, the deepest fall (BPHS 3.49-50)
Moon's aspect without other support (Saravali 25.43-48: various diseases, unhappiness)
Mercury's aspect (Saravali 25.43-48: lowly conduct, rejected by own people)
Venus's aspect (Saravali 25.43-48: insult and loss through women)
Placement in a dusthana (6th, 8th, 12th); Braha (pp. 51-52) says a planet there is spoiled, the 6th being the mildest
Vargottama does not help a fallen planet; Braha (pp. 13, 59) says it leaves it worse off
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka calls the native prosperous and wise despite debility; Saravali stresses distress. Commentators differ whether the 'exaltation lord' in cancellation is Saturn (lord of Capricorn) or Jupiter (the planet exalted in Cancer); modern practice often uses both. BPHS treats all of Cancer as debilitation, while Braha (p. 47) says that past 28 degrees Mars is technically no longer fallen.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Do not call it a 'bad Mars'. Describe protective, emotional energy that works best when expressed openly; note that cancellation is common. No illness, disability or marriage-failure predictions.

placement_entries.summary: Mercury in the 12th is read unfavourably by most classics (humiliation, poverty, idleness, cruelty), though Saravali and Bhrigu Sutras still call the person learned; modern writers reframe it as solitary, behind-the-scenes or foreign intellectual work.
common_outcomes: Humiliation or degradation (Phaladeepika 8.13; Saravali 30.49; Brihat Jataka 20.6 with 20.3)
Indolent or inactive (Phaladeepika 8.13; Saravali 30.49)
Poverty or penury (Jataka Parijata 8.98; Raman)
Cruelty (Phaladeepika 8.13; Saravali 30.49)
rare_outcomes: Learned and a good speaker, keeps promises (Saravali 30.49; Bhrigu Sutras 76-81)
Spends on religious charity (Bhrigu Sutras 76-81)
Entertains Brahmins and frightens enemies (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Extra-marital involvement and few children (Raman)

by_area.personality: Capricious, wayward, unhappy through distorted thinking (Raman); turns inward and thinks best alone (PanchangBodh); fond of giving things away (Bhrigu Sutras 76-81).
by_area.career: Foreign languages, overseas trade, translation, research libraries, hospitals, ashrams (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Poor (Jataka Parijata 8.98; Raman); spending mostly on books, courses, travel (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: When afflicted, sleep is broken by thinking (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Odious to relatives (Jataka Parijata 8.98); reserve or secrecy in speech (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Few children (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Spends on religious charities (Bhrigu Sutras 76-81); suits mantra, contemplation, dream life and release (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted or own sign: Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full (exaltation) through 3/4 (moolatrikona) and 1/2 (own sign) down to little in enemy signs
In a kendra in Gemini or Virgo it forms Bhadra Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Benefic association: expenditure on religious charity (Bhrigu Sutras 76-81)
Gemini or Virgo produces finished work (PanchangBodh)
Satyacharya, as read by Bhattotpala (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes): a benefic in the 12th reduces expenditure
weakeners_or_cancellations: Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 14 deg (12 deg retrograde)
Debilitation in Pisces (Brihat Jataka 20.11 scale; Bhrigu Sutras)
Mercury turns malefic when joined or aspected by malefics (Bhrigu Sutras commentary on house 1)
Malefic association: unstable mind and hostility to authority (Bhrigu Sutras 76-81)
Combustion is most common here (PanchangBodh)
placement_entries.disagreements: Learning: Phaladeepika 8.13 says unlearned and Jataka Parijata 8.98 senseless, but Saravali 30.49 and Bhrigu Sutras 76-81 say learned. Overall tone: classics and Raman are negative; PanchangBodh and VedicFeed reframe it positively as inward, foreign or research work. Satyacharya's rule (via Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes) that benefics in the 12th curb expenditure is not reflected in the house-specific verses.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Avoid the classical labels (cruel, poor, senseless). Present as a private, inward or behind-the-scenes mind, good for research, languages, foreign links and contemplation, with a caution about worry and overspending.

placement_entries.summary: Mercury in Cancer (Karka), the Moon's water sign, which Mercury treats as an enemy's sign, gives an imaginative, emotional and changeable intellect: talented with words and music but restless, talkative and prone to friction with relatives.
common_outcomes: Learned and poetic, with a feeling-led way of thinking
Restless and changeable; may take up many occupations
Inclination to live or work away from the birthplace
Fond of music; talkative
rare_outcomes: Saravali says popularity may come through the reputation of ancestors
Brihat Jataka 18.9: income from water or water-related trades, together with enmity from one's own people
Saravali mentions loss of wealth through romantic involvements

by_area.personality: Saravali 26.7-8: fickle-minded, prattling, fond of arguments.
by_area.career: Saravali 26.7-8: interested in many jobs, a good poet. Brihat Jataka 18.9: earns through water.
by_area.finance: Brihat Jataka links gains to water; Saravali warns of money lost through enmity with women.
by_area.relationships: Saravali 26.7-8: fond of the company of women, but loses wealth through enmity with them.
by_area.family: Both main texts mention hostility with relatives (Brihat Jataka 18.9 Sastri: hated by his relations), even as the ancestors' fame brings popularity (Saravali).

strengtheners: Saravali 26.43-48: Jupiter's aspect makes the native a great scholar, dear to all and to the ruler, who goes beyond the usual bounds of learning; Venus' aspect gives beauty, skill in singing and instruments, and fortune
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 26.43-48: Moon's aspect brings loss of wealth or vigour and misery through women; Mars' aspect brings little learning, lying and invention of falsehoods; Saturn's aspect brings vanity, imprisonment and hostility to siblings and elders
Enemy's sign: Braha and BPHS both list the Moon as Mercury's enemy; Phaladeepika 3.19: a planet in an enemy's house is 'distressed'

James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (Sun and 'Combustion' sections): a planet within about 8 degrees of the Sun is combust and its significations and the houses it rules are spoiled; Raman (Budha-Aditya Yoga) suggests Mercury may partly escape this
placement_entries.disagreements: The texts agree on family friction. Saravali stresses poetic talent and restlessness; Brihat Jataka stresses water-related income. Mercury regards the Moon as an enemy (BPHS ch. 3; Braha), though the Moon regards Mercury as a friend; five-fold (panchadha) friendship can change the relationship in an individual chart.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as an imaginative, emotionally attuned mind that benefits from structure and from not taking family disagreements to heart. Avoid predicting estrangement or financial loss; mention them only as areas to handle with care.

placement_entries.summary: Jupiter in the 5th gives intelligence and good counsel in every text; on children the texts split sharply, Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata seeing few or distress, Saravali and Bhrigu Sutras many.
common_outcomes: Intelligent (Brihat Jataka 20.7; Phaladeepika 8.15; Bhrigu Sutras 24-31; Raman)
Adviser or minister to rulers (Phaladeepika 8.15; Raman)
Clever in counsel, virtuous (Jataka Parijata 8.73)
Learned, happy, wealthy (Saravali 30.54)
rare_outcomes: Distress through children (Phaladeepika 8.15); few sons (Jataka Parijata 8.73)
Many sons and friends (Saravali 30.54); many prosperous children (Bhrigu Sutras 24-31)
A responsible post early in life, around the 18th year (Bhrigu Sutras 24, as read by its commentator)
Wealth through children (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Courageous and always happy (Saravali 30.54); good conversationalist, feeds others (Bhrigu Sutras 24-31); discriminating, decorous manners (Raman).
by_area.career: Adviser to rulers (Phaladeepika 8.15); logic, law, preceptor (Raman); orator and imaginative writer (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).
by_area.finance: Choice riches (Jataka Parijata 8.73); weak 5th lord can bring fines or losses through government (Bhrigu Sutras 26-29 as interpreted by the commentator).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Saravali 30.54); good friends and vehicles (Raman).
by_area.family: Children: few or a source of distress (Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata) versus many and prosperous (Saravali, Bhrigu Sutras, Raman); PanchangBodh says never judge timing or number of children from this alone.
by_area.spirituality: Mantra, past merit, god-fearing (Raman; PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Benefic aspect on Jupiter protects children even with Rahu/Ketu (Bhrigu Sutras 31)
Strengthened Jupiter: a smooth life (Raman)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
Weak 5th lord (malefic, enemy or debilitated sign): loss of children or only one (Bhrigu Sutras 26-29 as interpreted)
With Rahu or Ketu: harm to children unless a benefic aspects (Bhrigu Sutras 30-31)
'Karako bhava nashaya' (significator in its own house harms it) is invoked here by some; PanchangBodh calls it debated
placement_entries.disagreements: Children: Phaladeepika 8.15 (distress) and Jataka Parijata 8.73 (few sons) versus Saravali 30.54, Bhrigu Sutras 24-31 and Raman (many). The Bhrigu Sutras commentator attributes Phaladeepika's view to the 'karako bhava nashaya' maxim; PanchangBodh calls that maxim debated.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with intelligence, judgement and teaching ability. Never predict difficulty with children from this placement; say the texts differ and the full 5th house decides.

placement_entries.summary: Jupiter in Sagittarius (Dhanu) is in its moolatrikona (0-10 degrees) and own sign (10-30 degrees): a strong, dharmic Jupiter that gives a teacher, priest or adviser, charitable, learned, well-travelled and drawn to solitude and pilgrimage. Hamsa Yoga if in a kendra.
common_outcomes: Teacher, preceptor or guide; conducts rites or ceremonies
Charitable, helpful and loyal to one's own
Learned in scripture or philosophy
Travels widely; visits sacred places
rare_outcomes: Saravali 27.17-18: may lead a region or serve as a minister
Brihat Jataka 18.13 (own sign): provincial ruler, minister, army commander or wealthy
Hamsa Yoga in a kendra

by_area.personality: Saravali 27.17-18: charitable, helpful, friendly to his own people, prefers solitude. Foss (name 52): Sagittarius is Jupiter's male sign, the priest or educator; its challenge is appreciating other people's opinions.
by_area.career: Saravali 27.17-18: a preceptor, head of a region or a minister. Brihat Jataka 18.13 (own sign): a king, minister, commander or very wealthy.
by_area.finance: Saravali: lasting wealth.
by_area.relationships: Saravali: friendly to his own people.
by_area.spirituality: Strong: rites, vows, initiations and pilgrimage (Saravali 27.17-18).

strengtheners: Moolatrikona 0-10 degrees (BPHS 3.53); Foss (name 45) calls Sagittarius the moolatrikona and 'most favoured' of Jupiter's signs. Phaladeepika 3.18 calls a planet in moolatrikona 'happy' and in own sign 'confident'
Hamsa Yoga if in a kendra (Phaladeepika 6.1, 6.3; Raman no. 19)

Saravali 27.55-60 (Sagittarius/Pisces group): Moon's aspect gives many kinds of happiness, a fortunate marriage and wealth; Mercury's aspect gives a minister's or ruler's standing with wealth and children; Venus' aspect gives learning, long life and Lakshmi's blessing
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 27.55-60: Sun's aspect brings enmity with authority and loss of wealth and relatives; Mars' aspect, injury in conflict, cruelty and loss of children; Saturn's aspect, fear and neglect by others
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (rules of interpretation): planets in kendras are powerful, in trikonas enhanced, in the 6th, 8th or 12th spoiled
placement_entries.disagreements: Strong agreement. Saravali emphasises the teacher or priest role, Brihat Jataka the worldly rank of an own-sign Jupiter, Foss the risk of being sure of one's own opinions.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a principled, generous, knowledge-sharing nature. Keep worldly rank conditional on the rest of the chart.

placement_entries.summary: Venus in the 10th is read as renown, honour and wealth, often through women, land or the arts; all classical texts read are favourable.
common_outcomes: Widely renowned (Phaladeepika 8.19; Saravali 30.71; Raman)
Wealthy (Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7; Saravali 30.71; Jataka Parijata 8.91)
Honour, happiness and wisdom (Saravali 30.71)
Many friends, social and influential (Phaladeepika 8.19; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Success in litigation (Saravali 30.71)
Wealth through a tenant of his land or through women (Jataka Parijata 8.91)
Earns through houses and buildings; many women work for him (Raman)
Healing powers; disrupted education (Raman)

by_area.personality: Contented (Phaladeepika 8.19); powerful (Jataka Parijata 8.91); social and friendly (Raman).
by_area.career: Decoration, fashion, entertainment, hospitality, luxury, diplomacy, counselling (PanchangBodh); property and buildings; with Saturn, cosmetics and women's goods (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth and fame (Saravali 30.71); wealth through land or women (Jataka Parijata 8.91).
by_area.relationships: Sexual happiness (Saravali 30.71); many friends (Phaladeepika 8.19).
by_area.family: Work supports home comfort (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: Respect for divine people (Raman); earns through religious work (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With Mercury, Jupiter and the Moon: vehicles, religious ceremonies, wide fame, many Raja yogas (Bhrigu Sutras 61)
In own sign as 10th lord: a distinguished Raja Yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
As a benefic in the 10th: Amala Yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Malavya Yoga lifts reputation even without digbala (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
With or aspected by a malefic: difficulties and obstacles in undertakings (Bhrigu Sutras 60)
No directional strength in the 10th (PanchangBodh)
placement_entries.disagreements: Classics agree it is favourable. Chamatkar Chintamani's narrower reading (earning through religious work) is noted by the Bhrigu Sutras commentator as too narrow. VedicFeed's betrayal and loss notes are unsourced.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as a career in beauty, arts, hospitality, property or diplomacy with good public standing. Avoid guaranteeing fame.

placement_entries.summary: Venus in Taurus (Vrishabha), its own earth sign, gives comfort, beauty, sensual refinement and prosperity: fine clothes, perfumes, land or livestock, generosity toward relatives and respected leadership. Malavya Yoga if in a kendra.
common_outcomes: Good looks, refined taste and enjoyment of comfort
Prosperity through land, agriculture, cattle, perfumes or fine goods
Generous; supports relatives
Learned in many fields and respected
rare_outcomes: Saravali 28.3-4: many partners and jewels (read as a rich social and romantic life)
Brihat Jataka 18.14 (own sign): wealth through own strength and intelligence, honoured by rulers, community leader, famous and fearless
Malavya Mahapurusha Yoga in a kendra (Phaladeepika 6.1, 6.3)

by_area.personality: Saravali 28.3-4: charitable, helps living beings, good appearance.
by_area.career: Saravali 28.3-4: agriculture and livelihood through cattle; a principal person. Brihat Jataka 18.14: powerful among his people, honoured by the ruler.
by_area.finance: Brihat Jataka 18.14: money by own exertion and intelligence. Saravali: gems, perfumes, garlands and fine clothes.
by_area.relationships: Saravali's 'many wives' is a period marker of wealth; Raman (Malavya) promises happiness from spouse and children when the yoga forms.
by_area.family: Supports relatives (Saravali).
by_area.spirituality: Raman (Malavya Yoga remarks): Malavya inclines to pleasure, with spiritual advancement in inverse ratio to comforts.

strengtheners: Own sign (Phaladeepika 3.18: 'confident'); Braha: Venus gives very good results in Taurus and Libra
Malavya Yoga in a kendra: strong body, resolute mind, wealth, good spouse and children, comforts, vehicles, fame, learning (Phaladeepika 6.1, 6.3; Raman no. 20)

Saravali 28.31-36 (Taurus/Libra group): Moon's aspect gives a good mother, wealth, respect and sons; Mercury's aspect gives charm, luck, wisdom and strength; Jupiter's aspect gives spouse, children, home and vehicles
Foss: Venus in its own sign can make a great artist
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 28.31-36: Mars' aspect brings a difficult spouse and loss of home or wealth through relationships; Saturn's aspect, little happiness or wealth and disease; Sun's aspect, a good spouse and wealth but dominated by women

James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (Sun and 'Combustion' sections): a planet within about 8 degrees of the Sun is combust and its significations and the houses it rules are spoiled
placement_entries.disagreements: None substantial. Saravali's 'many wives' is a period-specific marker of wealth and is not echoed by Brihat Jataka.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe comfort, beauty and steady prosperity as supported tendencies. Do not suggest multiple marriages; Saravali's line reflects its era.

placement_entries.summary: Saturn in the 10th is one of its most praised placements in the classics: authority as minister, judge or local leader, hard work and agriculture or public service, though modern authors stress sharp career rises and falls.
common_outcomes: Position of authority: king's minister, judge, leader of a group, village or city (Phaladeepika 8.24; Saravali 30.83; Raman HJH)
Wealth, valour and renown (Phaladeepika 8.24; Saravali 30.83; Raman HJH)
Great worker; agriculture or land-related work (Phaladeepika 8.24; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Sudden elevations and depressions in career (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Rath)
rare_outcomes: Pilgrimages and bathing in sacred rivers; ascetic leanings in later life (Bhrigu Sutras 44-45; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Residence or success in foreign countries (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Works for the downtrodden; dispassionate (Raman HJH)
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): poor livelihood and loss of parents early, though enemies are humbled

by_area.personality: Dispassionate, judicious (Raman HJH); ambitious, disciplined, organisational (Braha); stingy and bilious per Bhrigu Sutras 44-45.
by_area.career: Ruler, minister, judge or local leader (Raman HJH; Saravali 30.83; Phaladeepika 8.24); obstacles if Saturn is with a malefic, success with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 44-45); with the 8th lord in a malefic navamsa, a tyrannical superior (Raman HJH).
by_area.finance: Rich (Phaladeepika 8.24; Saravali 30.83); Bhrigu Sutras doubts financial benefit unless Saturn is a functional benefic (commentary).
by_area.health: Bilious constitution (Bhrigu Sutras 44-45; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.relationships: Braha: aspects on the 7th and 12th tone down sexual passions.
by_area.family: Rath: as a malefic in the 10th, Saturn obstructs the 9th (father/fortune) by argala.
by_area.spirituality: Becomes an ascetic in later life (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); Rath: Saturn's beneficial argala on the 12th supports practices such as pranayama.

strengtheners: Saturn in own sign or exaltation (Braha: power and fame grow with age, a rise in the 36th year); Sasa yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Aries, Taurus, Libra, Capricorn and Aquarius lagnas: Raja or Dhana yoga (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Association with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 44-45)
Uttara Kalamrita 4.16: malefics are auspicious in upachaya houses such as the 10th
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn with a malefic: career obstacles (Bhrigu Sutras 44-45)
BPHS 21.16: Saturn in the 10th with a debilitated planet while a malefic is 10th from the navamsa lagna leaves one without virtuous deeds
Saturn in Aries: early failures, unrecognised work (Braha)
Rath: Saturn here can cause vast fluctuations in fortune by obstructing the 9th house
placement_entries.disagreements: Phaladeepika, Saravali and Raman are strongly positive; Bhrigu Sutras gives little beyond pilgrimage and stinginess, and Chamatkar Chintamani is negative. Rath and Braha qualify the positive view with marked fluctuation.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a career built on responsibility, endurance and public service, with authority that grows over time; prepare the person for cycles of advance and setback rather than promising fame.

placement_entries.summary: Saturn in Taurus sits in the sign of its friend Venus. Classical texts describe a serving or dependent position, modest means and attraction to pleasure, while Raman's modern list adds success, cleverness and self-restraint, and his dasa note speaks of good income.
common_outcomes: Service or dependent work and many assignments (Saravali 29.3-4)
Strong attraction to partners and pleasure (Saravali 29.3-4; Brihat Jataka 18.18)
Raman lists success, power, cleverness, persuasiveness, love of solitude and self-restraint (HPA ch.22)
Raman's dasa note: gains from land and agriculture and good income (HPA ch.24)
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.18 mentions limited power and several marriages

Saravali 29.32: Moon aspect brings wealth through women and honour from ministers; 29.35: Jupiter aspect makes one liked, charitable and industrious; 29.36: Venus aspect brings gems, strength and royal favour
Saravali 29.31: Sun aspect makes one learned but losing wealth

by_area.personality: Raman: clever, persuasive, likes solitude, self-restrained but a worrier (HPA ch.22).
by_area.career: Service and many assignments (Saravali 29.3-4); agriculture and land gains in Saturn's dasa (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.finance: Saravali 29.3-4 says bereft of wealth; Raman's dasa note gives great income (HPA ch.24); benefic aspects improve wealth (Saravali 29.32, 29.36).
by_area.relationships: Classical texts flag attraction to women and several unions (Saravali 29.3-4; Brihat Jataka 18.18).

strengtheners: Venus is Saturn's friend (Braha; Bhavartha Ratnakara 15.7 lists Taurus as friendly for Saturn)
Moon, Jupiter or Venus aspecting Saturn (Saravali 29.32, 29.35, 29.36)
Phaladeepika 9.16: a planet in a friend's sign brings success through friends and support
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury aspect is described as weakening and base (Saravali 29.34)
Sun aspect costs wealth (Saravali 29.31)
placement_entries.disagreements: Saravali calls the native poor; Raman's sign list calls him successful and powerful and his dasa note promises income. The friendly-sign rule (Phaladeepika, Bhavartha Ratnakara, Braha) supports the more favourable reading.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise patient building of security and the need for discipline with comfort. Do not predict infidelity or multiple marriages; say relationships benefit from clear commitments.

placement_entries.summary: Rahu in the 6th is widely rated one of its best houses: victory over enemies and rivals, wealth and long life, though sources mention puzzling or chronic ailments.
common_outcomes: Defeats enemies and competitors, few or no enemies (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Frawley)
Wealthy and long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Braha)
Ailments that are hard to diagnose, or of the lower body (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH)
Fame and wealth (Foss name 80)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 8.26: troubled by enemies or by malefic planets (Sastri: 'demons'), with anal disease
Many cousins (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Success through foreigners (Frawley)
Bhrigu Sutras 14-16: tolerant and very happy; with the Moon, liaisons with women of high (royal) family

by_area.personality: Tolerant and very happy (Bhrigu Sutras 14-16); powerful and virile (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.career: Excels in detail work and service jobs, health or catering fields (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Braha); sickness of a puzzling nature (Raman HJH); can contribute to nervous-system disorders (Frawley); Rahu or Ketu in the 6th/8th causes stomach disorders (Santhanam's note to BPHS 17.3-5).
by_area.relationships: Raman HJH: private life may become scandalous.
by_area.family: Many cousins (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).

strengtheners: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics destroys all evils (Saravali 12.3-5; Raman HJH)
Malefics in upachaya houses (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo heightens the benefits (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon and Saturn joining Rahu here: liability to mental strain (Raman HJH)
Rahu aspected by Mars in the 6th or 8th: boils/carbuncles (Phaladeepika 14)
Rahu or Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with the lords of those houses: harm during their dasas (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
Phaladeepika 19.15 makes Rahu's dasa fully good only when Rahu is in a house other than 6, 8 or 12
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika and Raman HJH say the native is troubled by enemies, while Hindu Predictive Astrology says 'no enemies' and Chamatkar Chintamani, Braha, Foss and Frawley give victory. Frawley himself lists the 6th both as good for Rahu and as a difficult house for remedies.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as competitive strength and an ability to handle conflict, illness and service work. Encourage attention to health without naming conditions.

placement_entries.summary: Rahu in Capricorn is in Saturn's sign; Saturn is Rahu's friend (Jataka Bharanam, Braha) and Rahu is said to act like Saturn (Frawley). Raman's dasa note is strongly favourable: promotion, state recognition and growing wealth.
common_outcomes: Raman's dasa note: sudden promotion, recognition by the state, family celebrations, more wealth (HPA ch.24)
Methodical, strategic ambition within institutions (astromedha.in, via summary)
rare_outcomes: Risk of using systems for personal gain is flagged by astromedha.in (via summary)

by_area.career: Promotion and official recognition (Raman HPA ch.24); career rise through organisations (astromedha.in, via summary).
by_area.finance: Increase of wealth (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.family: Marriage festivities at home in Rahu's dasa (Raman HPA ch.24).

strengtheners: Strong Saturn (dispositor and friend; Braha; Frawley pp.256-257)
Braha: the nodes do better in the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th houses; Frawley: Rahu works best in the 9th or 10th with that house's ruler strong
weakeners_or_cancellations: Weak or afflicted Saturn (Frawley pp.256-257)
placement_entries.disagreements: Friendly sign in the friendship lists (Jataka Bharanam, Braha); neutral in some modern treatments (astromedha). No classical sign verse found; Raman's dasa note supports a favourable reading.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Highlight strategic, patient ambition; frame status attachment as a balance point.

placement_entries.summary: Ketu in the 12th is read in two ways: classical verses stress secret wrongdoing, wasteful spending and eye trouble, while many later and modern authors regard it as an excellent placement for spiritual liberation, charity and foreign residence.
common_outcomes: Expenditure, sometimes wasteful (Phaladeepika 8.33; Braha) or on charities (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Eye troubles (Phaladeepika 8.33; Bhrigu Sutras 31-32; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
Spiritual insight and interest in liberation (Frawley; Braha)
Restless mind, foreign residence, travel (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): like a king, spends on charities, enemies vanquished
Ability to ward off negative psychic influences (Frawley)
Foss name 74: heroism or enmity
Inherited property may be lost (Raman HJH)

by_area.personality: Capricious, unsettled (Hindu Predictive Astrology); restless, wandering mind (Raman HJH); discriminating (Braha).
by_area.finance: Spends on vile things and destroys wealth (Phaladeepika 8.33); unexpected expenses and debts (Braha); spends on charities (Chamatkar Chintamani); inherited property may be lost (Raman HJH).
by_area.health: Eye diseases (Phaladeepika 8.33; Chamatkar Chintamani); left eye or ear (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Befriended by lower classes (Raman HJH); little sexual pleasure (Braha).
by_area.family: Few children (Bhrigu Sutras 31-32).
by_area.spirituality: Ketu does well in the 12th, giving spiritual insight (Frawley); excellent for a spiritual seeker (Braha). BPHS 33 places liberation with Ketu in the 12th from the Karakamsa (a different reference point).

strengtheners: Ketu unaspected by malefics in the 12th, or with a benefic in its own/exalted sign (Frawley, on strengthening Ketu)
Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: few unexpected expenses, fine spiritual tendencies, success abroad (Braha)
Benefic aspect (BPHS 33, for Ketu in the 12th from Karakamsa, especially in Aries or Sagittarius)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Malefic aspect or conjunction blocks liberation in the Karakamsa rule (BPHS 33)
Ketu in the 6th, 8th or 12th associated with those houses' lords: harm in its dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 17-18)
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Phaladeepika is wholly negative; Chamatkar Chintamani gives royal status and charity; Frawley and Braha make the 12th Ketu's best house for spirituality. The well-known 'Ketu in 12th gives moksha' rule in BPHS is counted from the Karakamsa, not the lagna.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with the inward, spiritual and charitable potential, and with life or work abroad; suggest mindful spending and rest. Do not promise liberation or discuss after-death states.

placement_entries.summary: Ketu in Cancer, the Moon's sign, detaches from home and emotional comfort. Braha expects the nodes to do worse in the luminaries' signs and Raman's dasa note speaks of displacement and family strain, yet both Raman and Foss see a turn toward philosophy and meditation; in one Jataka Bharanam view the Moon is Ketu's friend.
common_outcomes: Raman's dasa note: displacement from one's place, family strain, quarrels with friends, and initiation into philosophical knowledge (HPA ch.24)
Foss: Ketu in the 4th or in Cancer with the Moon can open a meditative bliss, if one turns to it (name 61)
Heightened intuition; difficulty receiving comfort (astromedha.in, via summary)

by_area.relationships: Quarrels with friends in Ketu's dasa (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.family: Displacement from home and family strain are themes, not certainties (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.spirituality: Philosophical initiation (Raman HPA ch.24); meditation as the route to Ketu's bliss (Foss, name 61).

strengtheners: Strong, well-aspected Moon (dispositor; Frawley p.258)
Meditation practice (Foss, name 61)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Weak Moon (Frawley p.258)
Braha: the nodes, as enemies of the luminaries, may give worse results in the Moon's sign
Frawley: the nodes in water signs tend to negate the water element (p.115)
placement_entries.disagreements: Braha treats the luminaries' signs as hard for both nodes, but one teacher in Jataka Bharanam makes the Moon Ketu's friend. Raman and Foss both find a spiritual upside despite the domestic strain.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak of inner self-reliance and intuition; never predict loss of mother or home.

placement_entries.summary: The self is drawn toward expenditure, distance and withdrawal: classical texts warn of reduced comfort, heavy spending and anger unless benefics help; modern readers add foreign residence and spiritual inclination.
common_outcomes: high or uncontrolled expenses
living in a foreign land (Charak)
visits to holy places and charitable spending (Raman)
less physical ease unless benefics support
rare_outcomes: BPHS: wasteful spending and anger when no benefic aspect or conjunction

by_area.personality: Can be quick-tempered (BPHS 24.12); Rath 4.4.12: the cause of own misfortunes, short temper, a spendthrift.
by_area.career: Losses and little success in business enterprises unless fortified (Raman HTJH I); Charak: lives in a foreign land.
by_area.finance: Many losses (Raman); spending patterns follow the nature of the lagna and 12th lords (Rath 4.4.12); when strong, inherited riches are spent on charity (Raman).
by_area.health: Classical texts reduce bodily comfort (BPHS 12.1, 24.12; Charak); no medical predictions.
by_area.spirituality: Visits holy places; when well placed, emotionally balanced and dedicated to public welfare (Raman HTJH I).

strengtheners: benefic aspect or conjunction (BPHS 24.12 conditions the bad results on their absence)
lagna lord in own sign in the 12th (Aquarius lagna: Saturn in Capricorn) - lagna ownership predominates
Jupiter's aspect or a spiritually oriented D9 supports the moksha side
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association without benefic aspect (BPHS 12.1, 24.12)
weak lord: Phaladeepika 15.9 says harm is severe when the lord is weak
debilitation: Libra lagna, Venus in Virgo
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical texts and Rath treat this as unfavourable; Raman gives a charitable, public-service expression when the lord is well placed; Charak names living in a foreign land, which BPHS 24.12 does not state.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe as a placement of giving, distance and inner life; suggest mindful spending. Avoid predicting isolation, loss or illness.

placement_entries.summary: Wealth falls into the house of loss and expenditure: savings are hard to keep, the person may rely on others' resources, and BPHS adds a traditional caution about the eldest child; benefic links can turn spending toward good causes.
common_outcomes: spending exceeds saving
money spent abroad or on family, charity or comforts
reliance on others' resources at times
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: no happiness from the eldest child
BPHS 13.9: 2nd and 12th lords with benefics direct spending to dharmic causes

by_area.personality: Courageous or adventurous (BPHS 24.24; Charak: courageous, laborious); respectable (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.career: Government service and income through religious institutions (Raman); a natural-benefic 2nd lord makes a renowned trader (Charak).
by_area.finance: Main caution: wealth hard to keep (BPHS 24.24; Charak). Exchange of the 2nd and 12th lords, or the 2nd lord in the 12th with the 12th lord in the lagna aspected by a maraka, gives poverty (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Nirdhana st. 2-3).
by_area.family: Traditional line about little happiness from the eldest child (BPHS 24.24; Charak) or from an elder brother (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on religious causes when benefics are involved (BPHS 13.9); income through ecclesiastical sources (Raman).

strengtheners: exaltation: Aries lagna (Venus in Pisces) and Gemini lagna (Moon in Taurus)
benefic conjunction, turning expenditure toward good causes (BPHS 13.9)
strong lord limits loss (Phaladeepika 15.9)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Aquarius lagna, Jupiter in Capricorn
11th lord also in a dusthana (BPHS 13.8)
malefic association
exchange of the 2nd and 12th lords: poverty (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Nirdhana st. 2)
12th lord in the lagna aspected by a maraka at the same time: poverty (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Nirdhana st. 3)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS renderings differ: 'depends on others' fortune' vs 'covets others' wealth'. Raman is milder (respectable, government service, ecclesiastical income). The family caution names the eldest child (BPHS, Charak) or an elder brother (Raman). Bhavartha Ratnakara exempts Aries lagna.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Advise mindful spending and saving; mention giving and foreign links positively. Do not predict poverty or problems with a child.

placement_entries.summary: Effort and enterprise shape the career: all comforts and self-earned wealth, with a traditional caution about supporting unworthy people.
common_outcomes: career built through effort and skill
self-earned wealth and comforts
gain from work-related travel (Raman)
support from siblings (Raman)
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: supporting or associating with difficult or wicked women

by_area.personality: Happy and intelligent (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.career: Strong career through initiative (BPHS 24.34); gains from journeys connected with the profession (Raman); honoured by the ruler (Charak).
by_area.finance: Self-made wealth (BPHS 24.34; Raman: becomes rich; Charak: earns through own efforts).
by_area.relationships: BPHS and Charak (supporting a wicked woman) and Raman (a quarrelsome, unfaithful spouse) carry harsh traditional lines; do not predict.
by_area.family: Siblings do well and help the native in every way (Raman).

strengtheners: own sign: Leo lagna (Venus in Taurus, also 10th lord) and Aquarius lagna (Mars in Scorpio, also 10th lord)
exaltation: Libra lagna, Jupiter in Cancer
Mars with dig bala in the 10th
if the 3rd and 10th lords are conjoined or aspect each other, the 3rd lord's dasa gives fortune while the 10th lord's does not (Bhavartha Ratnakara XI st. 4)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction or combustion
placement_entries.disagreements: All sources agree on self-made wealth; the spouse/association line takes a different form in each (BPHS and Charak: supporting a wicked woman; Raman: a quarrelsome spouse).
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Positive about self-made career. Omit the line about women or present it only as an archaic textual statement if asked.

placement_entries.summary: Home and comforts fall into the house of loss and distance: BPHS says domestic comforts are lacking, with bad habits, foolishness and idleness; modern readers stress living away from the birthplace or abroad.
common_outcomes: living away from birthplace or abroad (jagannathhora.com, practitioner site)
high home-related expenses
reduced domestic ease
need to guard against bad habits or inertia
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: vices, foolishness and laziness

by_area.personality: Can drift toward indulgence or inertia (BPHS 24.48; Charak: foolish, indolent).
by_area.finance: Bad finances and loss of property (Raman HTJH I; 'Important Combinations': the 4th lord in a dusthana loses property); homelessness in Charak's list (traditional).
by_area.family: Little domestic happiness (BPHS 24.48; Raman); Charak says the father lives in a foreign land.
by_area.spirituality: Contemplative residence possible (jagannathhora.com, practitioner site).

strengtheners: exaltation: Taurus lagna (Sun in Aries) and Scorpio lagna (Saturn in Libra)
benefic aspect (Phaladeepika 15.5)
strong lord: injury is slight (Phaladeepika 15.9)
Cancer lagna: Venus as 4th and 11th lord gives yoga in the 12th or 2nd (Bhavartha Ratnakara I, Karkataka st. 3)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Leo lagna, Mars in Cancer
malefic affliction; weak Moon
4th lord in a dusthana: loss of property and wealth (Raman HTJH I, 'Important Combinations')
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Charak are negative about home, property and character; Bhavartha Ratnakara makes an exception for Venus with Cancer lagna. Modern practitioners recast the placement as foreign residence, which BPHS 24.48 does not state; Charak puts the foreign land on the father.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak of finding home away from the birthplace and building good routines. Never call the person foolish or lazy.

placement_entries.summary: The 5th lord in its own house strengthens intelligence, merit and the house of children. BPHS and Phaladeepika make the children result depend on benefic influence; Raman and Braha add mantra, mathematics and leadership of religious bodies.
common_outcomes: Highly intelligent, virtuous and dear to friends (BPHS 24.53; Braha)
Children when benefics influence the lord (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9); Raman: a number of sons when favourable
Great in one's own field; expertise in mantra, mathematics or scripture (Raman; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Raman and Braha: may head a religious or spiritual institution
Braha: interest in politics or rulership; successful investments and speculation
Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.16 and 9.19: the 5th lord in the 5th together with the 4th lord in the 4th gives fortune and vehicles, and with the 10th lord in the 10th gives power and fame
Bhavartha Ratnakara (ch. XI st. 5): 5th, 7th and 9th lords in their own houses give holy dips during their periods
Raman, afflicted: concerns for children, not keeping one's word, wavering mind, cruelty (traditional view)

by_area.personality: Virtuous and dear to friends (BPHS 24.53); integrity and merit (Braha). Raman: wavering and unreliable if afflicted.
by_area.career: Raman: becomes great in his own line; expert in mantra shastra or mathematics; befriends the powerful. Braha: may be a ruler or politician.
by_area.finance: Braha: successful investments and a liking for speculation.
by_area.relationships: Braha: happy love affairs.
by_area.family: Children if benefics are involved, none or grief if malefics (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9); Raman: a number of sons when favourable.
by_area.spirituality: Knowledge of mantras or scriptures, religious-minded, strong past merit (Braha); expert in mantra shastra, may head a religious institution (Raman).

strengtheners: Benefic aspect or conjunction on the lord (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9)
The 4th lord in the 4th or the 10th lord in the 10th at the same time (Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.16, 9.19)
Jupiter joining or aspecting the 5th lord (Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.19: birth of children is indicated)
The 5th lord a benefic and aspected by a benefic or placed in a benefic sign (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 231 Buddhimaturya: intelligence and good character)
The 5th lord well placed and in a vaiseshikamsa (Phaladeepika 16.15: intelligent and open-hearted)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Malefic aspect or conjunction with no benefic aspect (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9: loss of children)
Raman: an afflicted lord gives contrary results
When Jupiter, the natural significator of children, is itself the 5th lord in the 5th, the 'karaka in its own bhava harms it' dictum is sometimes applied; see disagreements
placement_entries.disagreements: Karaka debate: Bhavartha Ratnakara repeats the dictum that Jupiter in the 5th harms children (relevant when Jupiter is the 5th lord for Leo or Scorpio), but its translator Raman disagrees from experience and limits the harm to affliction by Mars, Saturn or Rahu. On the core placement, BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha agree that benefic or malefic influence decides the children result.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with intelligence, integrity and creative or spiritual gifts. Say children prospects depend on other factors in the chart; never predict childlessness.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of service and competition in the house of career. BPHS is favourable (well known, a gifted speaker, happy abroad, but critical of the father); Raman and Braha are not (enemies blocking career, changes, hypocrisy or dismissal in Raman's harsh lines).
common_outcomes: Career shaped by competition and enemies; obstacles to promotion (Braha; Raman)
Earnings through hard work, coming slowly (Braha)
Success or happiness in foreign countries (BPHS 24.70)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.70: well known among his people, a gifted speaker, not respectful toward the father
Raman: fortified, a show of orthodoxy covering unscrupulous conduct; weak, dismissal and formidable enemies (traditional view)
Braha: career in medicine; difficulty finding one's career or dharma
Raman, 300 Combinations no. 265 Vrana yoga (malefic 6th lord in the 10th) is a classical illness combination Raman says not to apply literally

by_area.personality: Gifted speaker (BPHS 24.70). Raman's 'poses as pious' line is a traditional view.
by_area.career: Well known (BPHS 24.70); enemies harm career, career changes, medicine (Braha); dismissal if weak (Raman).
by_area.finance: Braha: money comes slowly and after hard work.
by_area.family: Not respectfully disposed to the father (BPHS 24.70).
by_area.spirituality: Raman: outward orthodoxy without inner scruple (traditional view).

strengtheners: The 6th lord in a benefic's sign and aspected by benefics (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope p. 136: many friends)
The lagna lord stronger than the 6th lord, in a benefic's sign or amsa and aspected by a benefic (Phaladeepika 16.17: health and comfort)
6th, 7th and 10th lords in kendras or trikonas (Bhavartha Ratnakara 9.21: power and fame)
weakeners_or_cancellations: The 6th lord in a kendra joined or aspected by malefics (Phaladeepika 16.16; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope p. 136: constant trouble from enemies)
Raman: a weak lord gives dismissal and powerful enemies
Phaladeepika 15.5: a house occupied by the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th suffers, unless a benefic aspects it
Phaladeepika 16.19: the house occupied by the 6th lord becomes a source of enmity for the native
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS 24.70 is favourable (fame, speech, success abroad); Raman and Braha are unfavourable for career. Bhavartha Ratnakara gives a fame yoga when the 6th, 7th and 10th lords all occupy kendras or trikonas.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Positive about persistence in a competitive career and success abroad. Mention the father relationship gently, if at all; no moral labels.

placement_entries.summary: Two kendras linked: partnership joins career and public standing. Raman and Braha read a devoted, career-minded spouse who helps the native's work and a profession involving travel or abroad; BPHS gives religious conduct, wealth and children but a spouse who does not follow the native's wishes.
common_outcomes: A spouse who helps the career or earns too (Raman; Braha)
A profession abroad or involving constant travel (Raman; Braha)
Religious conduct, wealth and children (BPHS 24.82)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.82: a disobedient spouse (traditional view); Raman instead says devoted and faithful
Raman, afflicted: an avaricious, over-ambitious spouse whose demands damage the career
Rath: the native may be obsessed with the spouse; in one example chart the 7th lord in the 10th links the first marriage to professional success
Bhavartha Ratnakara 9.21: 6th, 7th and 10th lords in kendras or trikonas give power and fame

by_area.personality: Religious (BPHS 24.82).
by_area.career: Career abroad or with constant travel (Raman; Braha); successful career aided by the spouse (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealth (BPHS 24.82); the spouse contributes income (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Devoted, faithful spouse (Raman) versus a disobedient one (BPHS 24.82); obsessed with the spouse (Rath).
by_area.family: Sons and the like (BPHS 24.82).
by_area.spirituality: Religious (BPHS 24.82).

strengtheners: The 7th lord or Venus joined or aspected by Jupiter or Mercury (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 239 Satkalatra: a noble, virtuous spouse)
The 7th house linked with a benefic and its lord strong (Phaladeepika 16.20: a virtuous spouse, happy marriage, children)
6th, 7th and 10th lords in kendras or trikonas (Bhavartha Ratnakara 9.21)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: affliction gives an over-ambitious spouse and a declining career
Raman: the results must not be applied literally without judging the whole chart and the strength of every planet (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 171)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS 24.82 calls the spouse disobedient; Raman calls the spouse devoted and faithful (unless afflicted).
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Positive about career and partnership; describe the spouse as independent and capable.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of hidden matters in the house of intelligence and children. BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on limited or troubled happiness from children and strain on the mind; BPHS and Braha both add long life, and BPHS wealth.
common_outcomes: Few children or worries connected with a child (BPHS 24.89; Raman; Braha)
Mental strain, lack of peace of mind, difficulty in studies (Raman; Braha); BPHS: dull-witted (traditional view)
Long-lived (BPHS 24.89; Braha) and wealthy (BPHS 24.89)
rare_outcomes: Raman: a child may get into trouble that affects the native's reputation; misunderstanding with the father; nervous strain (traditional notes)
Raman: with the 9th lord also in the 5th and the lagna lord debilitated, a harsh classical description of lacking knowledge and wealth
Braha: bad investments; gains from a partner's wealth and insurance
Raman, 300 Combinations no. 217: the 8th lord in the 5th exchanged with the 5th lord, with the Moon and 4th lord in the 6th, is a classical combination for loss of children

by_area.personality: Dull-witted (BPHS 24.89); no peace of mind (Braha); possible nervous strain (Raman). Traditional views.
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.89); bad investments but gains from a partner's wealth or insurance (Braha).
by_area.health: Raman: bodily ill-health and nervous strain under heavy affliction (traditional notes only).
by_area.relationships: Braha: unhappy love affairs.
by_area.family: Limited children (BPHS 24.89); friction with a child (Braha); a child's troubles (Raman); misunderstanding with the father (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Braha: no past-life credit brought forward (traditional view).

strengtheners: The 8th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope pp. 206-207: the evil is greatly reduced)
Saturn joining or aspecting the 8th lord (Bhavartha Ratnakara 7.2: long life)
Benefic aspect on the occupied house (Phaladeepika 15.5)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: an 8th lord fortified in a kendra or trikona intensifies its evil results (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 206)
The 8th lord with the 5th lord in the 5th, heavily afflicted (Raman)
Phaladeepika 15.5: a house occupied by the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th suffers, unless a benefic aspects it

Raman: results must be modified by the strength of the lagna, the Moon and the running dasha; for indications of wrong conduct, a strong lagna, Moon and 10th mean the temptation is overcome (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 207)
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a deep, searching mind that benefits from calm routines. Do not call the person dull; do not discuss lifespan or loss of a child.

placement_entries.summary: The fortune lord in the house of loss: classical and modern sources agree fortune is reduced, often with a modest background and hard work, while Braha and Rath add far-off lands and a strong pull towards moksha.
common_outcomes: fortune diminishes; spending on auspicious works (BPHS 24.108)
a poor background, hard work, success slow to come (Raman HTJH)
religious and noble yet often in want (Raman HTJH)
travel to far-off lands (Braha); fortune sought abroad (Rath, Carnegie chart)
excellent for moksha though weak for conventional religion (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.108 adds poverty from hosting guests (generosity outrunning means)
Phaladeepika's Nirbhagya yoga as a traditional caution
Rath (Crux ch. 5, Chart 25, Andrew Carnegie): the 9th lord in the 12th shows a poor father, and with Jupiter there the native sails to distant lands for his fortune
comfort of fine beds and a peaceful afterlife (Braha)
BPHS 20.19 has an exchange of 9th and 12th lords among harsh father-related verses; treat as traditional only

by_area.personality: Religious and noble (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Must work very hard and success may not come easily (Raman HTJH); fortune made in distant lands (Rath, Carnegie chart).
by_area.finance: Fortune diminishes (BPHS 24.108); a poor background and often in want (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: The father may be of modest means or have a difficult life (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on religious works (BPHS 24.108); excellent for moksha (Braha).

strengtheners: strong 9th lord (Phaladeepika 15.9; Raman HTJH: a very powerful 9th lord confers fortune even from a malefic house); benefic aspect (Phaladeepika 15.5)
own-sign case: Jupiter for Aries lagna owns the 9th and 12th and sits in Pisces, own sign; Mercury for Libra owns the 9th and 12th and sits in Virgo, exalted
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation or combustion (BPHS 20.12)
exchange with the 12th lord is flagged in BPHS 20.19 as difficult for the father (traditional)
JP 12.86: a 9th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, even with a benefic, gives only short-lived happiness
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are negative on fortune and the father. Braha and Rath add a positive side: far-off lands and moksha. Raman stresses poverty and effort; Rath's Carnegie example shows great fortune made abroad.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Say fortune may come through distant places, generosity and spiritual life rather than easy material luck. Never predict the father's death or illness; mention distance only as a possibility.

placement_entries.summary: The career lord in its own house: competence, courage and a strong professional life, with truthful conduct and respect for teachers.
common_outcomes: skilled in all kinds of work, courageous, truthful, devoted to teachers (BPHS 24.118)
strongly placed: highly successful and respected in the profession (Raman HTJH)
honours from government or prominent persons; prosperous and wealthy (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 16.27: with a benefic in the 10th, the strong 10th lord in its own sign gives renown, virtuous deeds and king-like affluence
three other planets with the 10th lord in the 10th: may become an ascetic (Raman HTJH); JP 15.35 similarly gives emancipation when the 10th lord joins four other planets in a kendra or trikona
weak and afflicted: dependent, seeking favours, fickle (Raman HTJH)

by_area.personality: Capable, courageous, truthful (BPHS 24.118); fickle-minded if weak and afflicted (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Highly successful and respected (Raman HTJH; Braha); routine and ordinary if the lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Prosperous and wealthy (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Devoted to gurus (BPHS 24.118); a powerful dharma (Braha).

strengtheners: the lord is in its own sign; a benefic in the 10th adds renown (Phaladeepika 16.27)
a strong 10th lord in the tenth harmonic (D10) shows great accomplishment (Frawley, harmonic charts)
weakeners_or_cancellations: weak and afflicted: dependence and lack of self-respect (Raman HTJH)
in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna: an ordinary career (Raman HTJH)
placement_entries.disagreements: None on the core; Raman makes the result sharply dependent on strength.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as a strong career signature. Avoid absolute promises of success.

placement_entries.summary: The gains lord in the house of expenditure: gains tend to flow out, often to good causes, and the person may have strong desires and dealings with foreigners or outsiders.
common_outcomes: spends on good causes; strong desires; associates with outsiders (BPHS 24.132)
losses in business; frequent fines and penalties (Raman HTJH)
expenses on account of an elder sibling's troubles (Raman HTJH; Braha)
many financial losses and unfulfilled desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.132 says lustful with many wives; a traditional line, not to be used as character judgement
Phaladeepika's Daridra yoga as a traditional caution
with the 12th lord: losses through varied expenditure; in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, debts (Raman HTJH, combinations)
comfortable bed pleasures (Braha)

by_area.personality: Strong desires (BPHS 24.132).
by_area.career: Business losses (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Gains flow out; fines and penalties (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.11: in a trika house with malefics, gains fail despite effort.
by_area.relationships: Few or bad friends (Braha). Traditional texts link it with multiple relationships (BPHS 24.132); treat with great care.
by_area.family: Burdened with domestic responsibilities; expenses for an elder sibling (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Spending on good causes (BPHS 24.132).

strengtheners: strong lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); benefic aspect (15.5)
own-sign case: for Pisces lagna Saturn owns 11th and 12th and is in Aquarius here
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association (BPHS 22.11)
malefics afflicting the 12th: wealth squandered (Raman HTJH, combinations)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS 24.132 includes spending on good causes alongside negative lines; Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are wholly negative on gains. For Pisces lagna the own-sign placement does not rescue the result in Frawley's view.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Say income may flow to travel, charity or distant ventures and that budgeting helps. Do not repeat the 'many wives' or 'lustful' line.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of loss in the house of home and mother: BPHS, Raman and Braha see little happiness from the mother and losses around land, vehicles and houses; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a strong spiritual pull.
common_outcomes: little happiness from the mother; daily losses concerning land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136)
mental restlessness, enmity of relatives and living abroad (Raman HTJH)
an ordinary residence and trouble from landlords (Raman HTJH); few fixed assets, car problems (Braha)
a strong spiritual nature: a moksha lord in a moksha house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: a well-placed 12th lord mitigates much of this (Raman HTJH)
rents out part of the home or buys houses to rent (Braha)
many career changes, as the 12th lord aspects the 10th (Braha)
with the 4th lord and benefics: substantial property and growing interest in spiritual literature (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.personality: Mentally restless and worried (Raman HTJH).
by_area.career: Many career changes (Braha).
by_area.finance: Losses on land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136; Braha).
by_area.family: Little happiness from the mother (BPHS 24.136; Braha); enmity of relatives (Raman HTJH).
by_area.spirituality: Desire for liberation (Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1); a well-placed 12th lord (Raman HTJH)
a strong Venus: own conveyance, though it gives trouble (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction of the 12th lord: trouble over property (Raman HTJH, periods)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on losses and distance from the mother; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a spiritual pull.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Suggest home life may involve moves or distance from the birthplace and that property needs careful handling. No claims about the mother's health.
